## Get more requests and spend less time reviewing them

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/111618-get-more-requests-and-spend-less-time-reviewing-them

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** November 21, 2025

Jobber now makes it easier for your team to capture, markup, and review the images that keep everyone aligned on the work being done.

You can now snap and upload multiple photos in a row, across Jobber, without waiting for each one to upload. And, with image markups, it’s simple to draw, add text, or place shapes directly on your images to highlight issues, document progress, or add helpful notes like measurements and instructions.

With a refreshed photo gallery, it's easier to scroll through photos in the mobile app and quickly find exactly what you need. Clear visuals with crucial details right on the photo mean stronger communication between the field and the office, so nothing gets lost in translation.

To learn more about image markups in Jobber, visit our Help Center.

Not on the Connect plan yet?

Build custom checklists and collect on-site photos to show proof of work.

Get started
Desktop App
Feature Update
Receptionist now turns hang ups into booked jobs
Shared by Kim • November 17, 2025

Every call matters. Now when a caller hangs up before finishing the conversation, your AI-powered Receptionist doesn’t stop there.

Receptionist instantly sends the caller a follow-up text message—giving you another chance to book the job, collect a request, or capture a message.

You decide what the follow-up text says, and Receptionist takes care of the rest.

Learn more about Receptionist.

Feature Update
Uplevel Your Client Communication with Images in Text Messages
M
Shared by Marc • October 28, 2025

You can now take your client conversations to the next level with images in two-way text messages — available directly in Jobber!

You already have the power of two-way text messaging in Jobber, and now it’s even better. You can attach images right from the mobile app or desktop Message Center, making it easier than ever to communicate clearly and professionally.

No more jumping between devices, channels, or phone numbers to keep your clients updated. With Jobber’s enhanced two-way messaging, you can start and carry on real-time conversations, share image updates, and stay connected - all in one place.

Send up to 5 images per message (max 5MB per image), along with up to 1,600 characters of text. Whether you’re sharing before-and-after photos, visual estimates, or on-site updates, this feature gives you plenty of flexibility to add clarity, professionalism, and accountability to every conversation.

To learn more about two-way SMS capabilities in Jobber, visit our Help Center.

Availability: Two-way text messaging is available on the Grow Plan in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. Please note that due to carrier limitations, receiving images (MMS) is not currently supported in Great Britain.

Mobile App
New Feature
Tackle admin work hands-free with Jobber Voice
Shared by Paige • October 27, 2025

Get more done without stopping what you’re doing. Jobber Voice lets you talk to Jobber in the mobile app to handle everyday tasks hands-free, like sending quotes, documenting work, or checking what’s next on your schedule. Just say what you need, and Jobber takes care of it.

For pros in the field, admin work never stops and can eat into billable hours. With Jobber Voice, you can stay focused on the job while Jobber handles more than 100 tasks—all powered by your voice.

Use Voice to:

Document work and send invoices
Create and send quotes
Get directions to your next job site
Communicate with clients to provide updates
Check performance and get business insights
Answer Jobber product questions
And more... without lifting a finger

Smarter duplicate detection: Requests now use better checks to determine if the client or property already exists, making it easier to prevent duplicates. Plus, address fields now use Google Autocomplete to speed up entry, match requests to existing properties, and reduce errors.
And more!

To learn more about Request Forms, visit our Help Center.

Customize your request forms

New Feature
Desktop App
Quote faster and win more work with new automations
Shared by Paige • October 06, 2025

Spend less time on admin and let Jobber keep your business moving with new quoting automations. Powered by Jobber AI, these automations help you win more jobs, stay on top of your pipeline, and keep everything running smoothly in the background.

Auto-drafted quotes: In seconds, Jobber AI can turn a request into a perfectly drafted quote, leveraging the request details, your past quotes, and saved templates. You can set this to run automatically every time a new request comes in, or use it on a one-off basis. Just review the draft and hit send.
High-value quote alerts: Get real-time alerts when a high-value quote is auto-drafted and in your pipeline, so you can contact the customer right away to secure the job.

Jobber AI recommends the best time to enable these automations in your workflow. Turn them on with a single click to quote faster, win more work, and deliver a smoother, more professional client experience.

To learn more about these new automations, visit our Help Center.

New Feature
Keep new work rolling in with Campaign Generator
M
Shared by Marc • September 29, 2025

Staying top of mind is the fastest way to grow your revenue. With Campaigns in Jobber, you can easily create, send, and automate professional email campaigns—all in one place.

Now with Campaign Generator, you can create professional email campaigns effortlessly in under a minute. Simply tell Jobber your campaign objective, and a targeted, polished, ready-to-send campaign will be generated for you in seconds. All you need to do is click ‘Send’.

Keeping your business top of mind has never been easier!

Get started with Campaigns

## Get paid as you work with progress invoicing

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/109291-get-paid-as-you-work-with-progress-invoicing

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** September 25, 2025

Break large jobs into multiple invoices with progress invoicing. By setting up a payment schedule on a quote or job, you’ll create clear expectations for your client and keep cash flowing as the project moves forward.

With progress invoicing, you can request a deposit and set up a detailed payment schedule tied to project milestones. Plus, your client has full transparency into what’s owed and when, so payments are never a surprise and you can build trust. As the job progresses, Jobber makes it easy to generate invoices at each stage, keeping your billing on track and reducing the risk of non-payment.

To learn more about progress invoicing, visit our Help Center

Desktop App
Feature Update
Websites are now multi-page and fully customizable—included in all Jobber plans
Shared by Kim • September 24, 2025

Having a website does more for your business than an Instagram or Facebook profile. Outrank competitors on Google, establish trust with new customers, and look professional from day one.

Now, you can launch a multi-page, high-converting website in minutes. Jobber gives you a head start by pre-loading your site with messaging and images tailored to your business. Just hit "publish" or make quick edits to make it yours.

Here’s what’s new:

Multiple pages: Easily add pages to your website, with service-specific request forms on each page to capture the right details.
Built-in SEO: Optimized keywords, service pages, and best practices baked in from the start.
Personalization: Set your brand colors, drag-and-drop new content sections, and connect your custom domain.
Receptionist: Your AI-powered Receptionist is included on your website—no add-on required—to answer questions, take requests, and book jobs.

Learn more about Jobber websites.

Integrations
Sync jobs and marketing with the new HighLevel integration
Shared by Stephanie • September 18, 2025

Keep your jobs and marketing in perfect sync. By connecting Jobber with HighLevel, your customer details and job information automatically flow between both platforms. That means your marketing campaigns can respond the moment a job is scheduled or updated, helping you capture more leads and stay connected with customers. You can even send automatic review requests after a job is complete, boosting your reputation while saving time on admin.

To get started, connect HighLevel in Jobber and set up your workflows.

Get started
Desktop App
Feature Update
Collect the right info every time with new job form fields
Shared by Paige • September 17, 2025

Now you can capture the exact details you need on every job with new job form field types: signatures, numbers, and date pickers. These additions make it easier for your team to collect information in the best format.

With the date picker, team members can quickly select dates from a calendar, reducing errors and keeping records accurate. Use the number field to capture quantities, measurements, or other numeric data in a consistent format. And with the new signature field, you can collect sign-off directly on-site, making approvals clear and traceable.

To learn more about setting up new job form fields, visit our Help Center

Feature Update
Mobile App
Create fast, impressive quotes—no matter where you are.
Shared by Cam • September 15, 2025

Send beautiful quotes straight from the job site and close deals faster with new quoting features now available in the mobile app.

Quote templates
Quickly create a new quote on your phone by starting with an existing template and making quick adjustments to match the job.

Advanced quote customization
Take your quotes further with an introduction, an image gallery, reviews, and attachments—features you love, now in the mobile app. With templates, your saved content and images come through instantly, so you can quickly send beautiful, impressive quotes even if you're not at your desk.

To learn more about advanced quote customization, visit our Help Center.

Advanced quote customization is available on Grow and Plus plans.

Integrations
Embed your Jobber online booking and request forms directly into your WordPress site
Shared by Stephanie • September 04, 2025

WordPress gives you powerful, easy-to-use tools to build and manage your website, complete with lightning-fast hosting.

With the new WordPress integration, seamlessly embed your online booking and request forms directly into your WordPress site, and turn website visitors into paying jobs. All new clients, bookings, and requests are automatically synced to Jobber, streamlining your workflow and ensuring you can respond to leads quickly.

To get started, connect WordPress in Jobber and start turning website visits into jobs. Visit the WordPress marketplace listing to get started!

Get started
Integrations
Send personalized direct mail with the PostcardMania integration
Shared by Stephanie • August 28, 2025

Easily reach homeowners in your service area with automated direct mail—now available through Jobber’s integration with PostcardMania. From Jobber, you can send personalized postcards, letters, brochures, and more to generate leads and follow up with potential clients.

Automatically build new mover lists in your service area, or send radius mailings around completed jobs to turn neighbors into new customers. Customize Jobber templates in our built-in editor or upload your own design, and add variable fields like a first name, address, or special offer for a personal touch.

Mailers are sent with a quick 1–3 business day turnaround, and with direct mail delivering up to 9X the response rate of email, you’ll stand out and win more business.

To get started, connect PostcardMania in Jobber and send your first mailer today.

Get started

Available to US accounts only

Desktop App
Feature Update
See where your revenue is coming from at a glance
Shared by Paige • August 28, 2025

The new revenue heatmap on the insights dashboard helps you see where your revenue comes from, for a clear picture of which areas are most valuable to your business! Calculated using the total value of invoices sent in the past 90 days, the heatmap makes it easy to spot your strongest markets and uncover new opportunities to grow.

Hotspots are colored based on revenue: the darker the shading, the more revenue generated in that geography. The heatmap transforms raw data into visual and easy-to-understand insights, helping you decide where to focus your marketing and resources for maximum impact!

To learn more about the revenue heatmap on the insights dashboard, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Develop a meaningful connection with your customers through customized review requests
M
Shared by Marc • August 26, 2025

Turn your great work into growth. With the latest updates to Reviews, you can ask for a review with the right message at the right time.

If your client doesn’t click the link in your initial review message, Jobber will automatically send up to two follow-up reminders. These reminders help increase your chances of collecting reviews without needing to follow up manually.

Now, these followup messages can be customized to say what you want.

To adjust the follow-up messages, select each follow-up from the settings menu, then set the timing, choose the channel (text or email), and customize the message. (Note: users without a dedicated phone number will only be able to select email).

Start connecting with customized review requests today!

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as part of the Marketing Suite add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Integrations
Force Fleet Tracking integration enhances On My Way texts with live tracking links
Shared by Stephanie • August 21, 2025

Give your customers real-time peace of mind. When your team taps On My Way in the Jobber app, the message can now include a live tracking link powered by Force Fleet Tracking - so customers can see the vehicle that’s en route to them.

The customer will receive an SMS with a unique Force Fleet Tracking link, which they can open to view the vehicle’s current location on a map. The link automatically expires once the visit is complete or after the scheduled end time.

To get started, connect Force Fleet Tracking and send an On My Way message from the Jobber app. Need a hand? Visit our Help Center or watch this video to learn more.

Get started

Available to US accounts on a Connect or higher plan using the Force Fleet Tracking integration

If your client doesn’t click the link in your initial review message, Jobber will automatically send up to two follow-up reminders. These reminders help increase your chances of collecting reviews without needing to follow up manually.

Now, these followup messages can be customized to say what you want.

To adjust the follow-up messages, select each follow-up from the settings menu, then set the timing, choose the channel (text or email), and customize the message. (Note: users without a dedicated phone number will only be able to select email).

Start connecting with customized review requests today!

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as part of the Marketing Suite add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Integrations
Force Fleet Tracking integration enhances On My Way texts with live tracking links
Shared by Stephanie • August 21, 2025

Give your customers real-time peace of mind. When your team taps On My Way in the Jobber app, the message can now include a live tracking link powered by Force Fleet Tracking - so customers can see the vehicle that’s en route to them.

The customer will receive an SMS with a unique Force Fleet Tracking link, which they can open to view the vehicle’s current location on a map. The link automatically expires once the visit is complete or after the scheduled end time.

To get started, connect Force Fleet Tracking and send an On My Way message from the Jobber app. Need a hand? Visit our Help Center or watch this video to learn more.

Get started

Available to US accounts on a Connect or higher plan using the Force Fleet Tracking integration

## Create fast, impressive quotes—no matter where you are.

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/107714-create-fast-impressive-quotes-no-matter-where-you-are

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** September 25, 2025

Break large jobs into multiple invoices with progress invoicing. By setting up a payment schedule on a quote or job, you’ll create clear expectations for your client and keep cash flowing as the project moves forward.

With progress invoicing, you can request a deposit and set up a detailed payment schedule tied to project milestones. Plus, your client has full transparency into what’s owed and when, so payments are never a surprise and you can build trust. As the job progresses, Jobber makes it easy to generate invoices at each stage, keeping your billing on track and reducing the risk of non-payment.

To learn more about progress invoicing, visit our Help Center

Desktop App
Feature Update
Websites are now multi-page and fully customizable—included in all Jobber plans
Shared by Kim • September 24, 2025

Having a website does more for your business than an Instagram or Facebook profile. Outrank competitors on Google, establish trust with new customers, and look professional from day one.

Now, you can launch a multi-page, high-converting website in minutes. Jobber gives you a head start by pre-loading your site with messaging and images tailored to your business. Just hit "publish" or make quick edits to make it yours.

Here’s what’s new:

Multiple pages: Easily add pages to your website, with service-specific request forms on each page to capture the right details.
Built-in SEO: Optimized keywords, service pages, and best practices baked in from the start.
Personalization: Set your brand colors, drag-and-drop new content sections, and connect your custom domain.
Receptionist: Your AI-powered Receptionist is included on your website—no add-on required—to answer questions, take requests, and book jobs.

Learn more about Jobber websites.

Shared by Stephanie • September 18, 2025

You can even send automatic review requests after a job is complete, boosting your reputation while saving time on admin.

To get started, connect HighLevel in Jobber and set up your workflows.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Collect the right info every time with new job form fields
Shared by Paige • September 17, 2025

Now you can capture the exact details you need on every job with new job form field types: signatures, numbers, and date pickers. These additions make it easier for your team to collect information in the best format.

With the date picker, team members can quickly select dates from a calendar, reducing errors and keeping records accurate. Use the number field to capture quantities, measurements, or other numeric data in a consistent format. And with the new signature field, you can collect sign-off directly on-site, making approvals clear and traceable.

To learn more about setting up new job form fields, visit our Help Center

Mobile App

Send personalized direct mail with the PostcardMania integration
Shared by Stephanie • August 28, 2025

Easily reach homeowners in your service area with automated direct mail—now available through Jobber’s integration with PostcardMania. From Jobber, you can send personalized postcards, letters, brochures, and more to generate leads and follow up with potential clients.

Feature Update

Shared by Paige • August 28, 2025

Give your customers real-time peace of mind. When your team taps On My Way in the Jobber app, the message can now include a live tracking link powered by Force Fleet Tracking - so customers can see the vehicle that’s en route to them.

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/104350-develop-a-meaningful-connection-with-your-customers-through-customized-review-requests

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** September 25, 2025

Break large jobs into multiple invoices with progress invoicing. By setting up a payment schedule on a quote or job, you’ll create clear expectations for your client and keep cash flowing as the project moves forward.

With progress invoicing, you can request a deposit and set up a detailed payment schedule tied to project milestones. Plus, your client has full transparency into what’s owed and when, so payments are never a surprise and you can build trust. As the job progresses, Jobber makes it easy to generate invoices at each stage, keeping your billing on track and reducing the risk of non-payment.

To learn more about progress invoicing, visit our Help Center

Desktop App
Feature Update
Websites are now multi-page and fully customizable—included in all Jobber plans
Shared by Kim • September 24, 2025

Having a website does more for your business than an Instagram or Facebook profile. Outrank competitors on Google, establish trust with new customers, and look professional from day one.

Now, you can launch a multi-page, high-converting website in minutes. Jobber gives you a head start by pre-loading your site with messaging and images tailored to your business. Just hit "publish" or make quick edits to make it yours.

Here’s what’s new:

Multiple pages: Easily add pages to your website, with service-specific request forms on each page to capture the right details.
Built-in SEO: Optimized keywords, service pages, and best practices baked in from the start.
Personalization: Set your brand colors, drag-and-drop new content sections, and connect your custom domain.
Receptionist: Your AI-powered Receptionist is included on your website—no add-on required—to answer questions, take requests, and book jobs.

Learn more about Jobber websites.

Integrations

Shared by Stephanie • September 18, 2025

Keep your jobs and marketing in perfect sync. By connecting Jobber with HighLevel, your customer details and job information automatically flow between both platforms. That means your marketing campaigns can respond the moment a job is scheduled or updated, helping you capture more leads and stay connected with customers. You can even send automatic review requests after a job is complete, boosting your reputation while saving time on admin.

To get started, connect HighLevel in Jobber and set up your workflows.

Feature Update

Integrations
Send personalized direct mail with the PostcardMania integration
Shared by Stephanie • August 28, 2025

Easily reach homeowners in your service area with automated direct mail—now available through Jobber’s integration with PostcardMania. From Jobber, you can send personalized postcards, letters, brochures, and more to generate leads and follow up with potential clients.

Automatically build new mover lists in your service area, or send radius mailings around completed jobs to turn neighbors into new customers. Customize Jobber templates in our built-in editor or upload your own design, and add variable fields like a first name, address, or special offer for a personal touch.

Mailers are sent with a quick 1–3 business day turnaround, and with direct mail delivering up to 9X the response rate of email, you’ll stand out and win more business.

To get started, connect PostcardMania in Jobber and send your first mailer today.

Available to US accounts only

Desktop App
Feature Update
See where your revenue is coming from at a glance
Shared by Paige • August 28, 2025

The new revenue heatmap on the insights dashboard helps you see where your revenue comes from, for a clear picture of which areas are most valuable to your business! Calculated using the total value of invoices sent in the past 90 days, the heatmap makes it easy to spot your strongest markets and uncover new opportunities to grow.

Hotspots are colored based on revenue: the darker the shading, the more revenue generated in that geography. The heatmap transforms raw data into visual and easy-to-understand insights, helping you decide where to focus your marketing and resources for maximum impact!

To learn more about the revenue heatmap on the insights dashboard, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Develop a meaningful connection with your customers through customized review requests
M
Shared by Marc • August 26, 2025

Turn your great work into growth. With the latest updates to Reviews, you can ask for a review with the right message at the right time.

If your client doesn’t click the link in your initial review message, Jobber will automatically send up to two follow-up reminders. These reminders help increase your chances of collecting reviews without needing to follow up manually.

Now, these followup messages can be customized to say what you want.

To adjust the follow-up messages, select each follow-up from the settings menu, then set the timing, choose the channel (text or email), and customize the message. (Note: users without a dedicated phone number will only be able to select email).

Start connecting with customized review requests today!

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

## Make job form fields mandatory and never miss a detail of the job

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/101383-make-job-form-fields-mandatory-and-never-miss-a-detail-of-the-job

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** August 05, 2025

Use the “Required” toggle on job form questions to make sure your team captures the most important details, every time. This improves job visibility and reduces delays caused by missing information.
​

With required questions on job forms, admins can ensure critical info is filled out before a visit is completed. Field workers see a progress bar as they go and are prompted to finish any missing responses before moving on.
​

If a visit is closed with unanswered required questions, field staff will be guided to complete them, and admins will be notified right away through the activity feed and Home page of Jobber. This helps everyone stay on the same page, reduces back-and-forth, and keeps work moving smoothly.
​

To learn more about required questions on job forms, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
See which marketing efforts bring in the most revenue
Shared by Paige • July 30, 2025

You can now better understand where your most valuable work is coming from with two new lead insights in Jobber.

The revenue by lead source chart—available on the insights dashboard—shows the total invoiced revenue tied to lead sources like Google, Facebook, and Instagram over the last 90 days. It gives you a quick, visual snapshot of what’s driving results.

For a deeper dive, use the lead source report to track the number of leads and revenue from each source over time. This makes it easier to know where to focus your marketing budget and effort.

To get started tracking lead sources and make smarter marketing decisions, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
More control over which users can access Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • July 11, 2025

Marketing Suite users can control which users can access the products in Marketing Suite. Whether you want to give access to a marketing agency or a relative who helps with your marketing, you're able to do so without needing to give them admin permissions.

Get started with Marketing Suite

To learn more about Marketing Suite, visit our Help Center.

Marketing Suite is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Easier communication with property contacts
Shared by Kim • May 30, 2025

Communicating with building managers, tenants, and other property-specific contacts just got simpler—especially for clients with multiple properties.

You can now assign contacts directly to individual properties in Jobber and control exactly which communications they receive. For example, you may want them to receive visit reminders but not invoices. Within the next few weeks, this will also include on-my-way texts.

Stay organized and keep everyone in the loop—without the hassle.

Get started

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Available on all plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Add multiple client contacts—and send the right info to the right people
Shared by Kim • May 15, 2025

Most jobs require contact with multiple people—like landlords, tenants, additional residents, or accounts payable.

Now you can add multiple contacts under a single client profile and control exactly which communications each one receives—like quotes, visit reminders, and final invoices.

That means less manual emailing, fewer mix-ups, and more time back in your day. Jobber keeps everyone in the loop automatically.

Get started

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Available on all plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get ready to win big this season with Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • May 14, 2025

Marketing Suite just got a serious upgrade to help you grow your business this season—not your admin time.

🛠️ Tailor your tools to work the way you do

Your timing matters. Send review requests at the moment that makes the most sense—after a visit, once a job is closed, or when an invoice gets paid. You’re in full control.

With the ability to toggle review requests on or off directly from the client profile, job, visit, or invoice, you’ll never send a review request to a client that is not the right fit.

💡 See what’s working and double down on it

Updated review insights will help you monitor trends in ratings, volume, and response rates—all of which are key drivers of local SEO and new business.

Your competition isn’t slowing down—and now, you don’t have to guess how you stack up. With the competitor analysis on Reviews, you get a snapshot of how your business compares to local competitors.

It is easier than ever to track the performance of your marketing campaigns over time. Plus, you can sort and search through your past efforts to easily spot your biggest wins.

Get inspired by smarter campaign templates that are aligned to your goals, helping you build better campaigns based on what’s worked before.

⚡️ Spend less time doing and more time growing

Referral reminders go out automatically after a job is closed, so your satisfied clients keep bringing in new ones without you having to follow up.

Campaign duplication lets you clone your top-performing emails in just a couple of clicks—no rebuilding from scratch.

Ready to Grow with Marketing Suite?

This season, let your marketing pull its weight.
You focus on the work—Marketing Suite handles the rest.

Get started with Marketing Suite

To learn more about Marketing Suite, visit our Help Center.

Marketing Suite is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Integrations
Know why your reps are losing sales, and how to fix it with Sales Ask
Shared by Ashley • May 01, 2025

When your team is out in the field, it’s hard to know how client meetings are going. Sales Ask and Jobber solve that by recording in-person meetings and giving you instant access to sales conversations and insights.

After each meeting, you’ll get a full transcript, a score showing how well your sales process was followed, and AI-driven coaching tips - directly in Jobber.

You’ll have everything you need to virtually coach your team and close more jobs.

Get started

Available on a Connect or higher plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Elevate your website with a custom domain & image gallery
Shared by Kim • April 21, 2025

Jobber makes it easy to quickly launch a website with all the essentials your customers expect from a professional business. Now, you can add an extra layer of polish to your website—and promote it with pride with a custom domain.

What’s new:

Add a custom domain to your website (ex. www.yourbusinessname.com). You can connect a custom domain you already own, or purchase a new one through Jobber’s partners at a discount.
Show off your work with a professional image gallery.

Get started

To learn more about Websites, visit our Help Center.

Available on a Core or higher plan.

Integrations
Simplify how your team manages customer calls with OpenPhone
Shared by Ashley • April 10, 2025

OpenPhone is a collaborative phone system that helps your team stay on top of calls, texts, and contacts - all in one simple app that works across your devices. Every time you chat with a client or lead, OpenPhone creates an AI-powered summary so you don’t have to jot down notes or worry about missing details.

Now with our new OpenPhone integration, those summaries automatically sync to Jobber. You’ll see past conversations linked to the right clients and requests, so it’s easy to pick up where you left off, stay organized, and deliver a 5-star customer experience they’ll rave about.

Get started

Available on a Core or higher plan.

Desktop App
New Feature
Your business health metrics in an all NEW dashboard
Shared by Paige • March 24, 2025

The new insights dashboard gives you a quick, at-a-glance view of the numbers that matter most—like revenue trends, lead conversion rates, and job capacity. No more jumping between reports to understand how your business is doing. Want to dive deeper? Just click ‘View report’ on any graph to open the corresponding report.

You’ll find the insights dashboard under the new Insights tab in the side navigation. All your usual reports are available in the Reports tab.

Learn more about the insights dashboard in our Help Center.

The insights dashboard is available on all plans.

## More control over which users can access Marketing Suite

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/97291-more-control-over-which-users-can-access-marketing-suite

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** August 05, 2025

Use the “Required” toggle on job form questions to make sure your team captures the most important details, every time. This improves job visibility and reduces delays caused by missing information.
​

With required questions on job forms, admins can ensure critical info is filled out before a visit is completed. Field workers see a progress bar as they go and are prompted to finish any missing responses before moving on.
​

If a visit is closed with unanswered required questions, field staff will be guided to complete them, and admins will be notified right away through the activity feed and Home page of Jobber. This helps everyone stay on the same page, reduces back-and-forth, and keeps work moving smoothly.
​

To learn more about required questions on job forms, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
See which marketing efforts bring in the most revenue
Shared by Paige • July 30, 2025

You can now better understand where your most valuable work is coming from with two new lead insights in Jobber.

The revenue by lead source chart—available on the insights dashboard—shows the total invoiced revenue tied to lead sources like Google, Facebook, and Instagram over the last 90 days. It gives you a quick, visual snapshot of what’s driving results.

For a deeper dive, use the lead source report to track the number of leads and revenue from each source over time. This makes it easier to know where to focus your marketing budget and effort.

To get started tracking lead sources and make smarter marketing decisions, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
More control over which users can access Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • July 11, 2025

Marketing Suite users can control which users can access the products in Marketing Suite. Whether you want to give access to a marketing agency or a relative who helps with your marketing, you're able to do so without needing to give them admin permissions.

Get started with Marketing Suite

To learn more about Marketing Suite, visit our Help Center.

Marketing Suite is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Easier communication with property contacts
Shared by Kim • May 30, 2025

Communicating with building managers, tenants, and other property-specific contacts just got simpler—especially for clients with multiple properties.

You can now assign contacts directly to individual properties in Jobber and control exactly which communications they receive. For example, you may want them to receive visit reminders but not invoices. Within the next few weeks, this will also include on-my-way texts.

Stay organized and keep everyone in the loop—without the hassle.

Get started

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Available on all plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Add multiple client contacts—and send the right info to the right people
Shared by Kim • May 15, 2025

Most jobs require contact with multiple people—like landlords, tenants, additional residents, or accounts payable.

Now you can add multiple contacts under a single client profile and control exactly which communications each one receives—like quotes, visit reminders, and final invoices.

That means less manual emailing, fewer mix-ups, and more time back in your day. Jobber keeps everyone in the loop automatically.

Get started

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Available on all plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get ready to win big this season with Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • May 14, 2025

Marketing Suite just got a serious upgrade to help you grow your business this season—not your admin time.

🛠️ Tailor your tools to work the way you do

Your timing matters. Send review requests at the moment that makes the most sense—after a visit, once a job is closed, or when an invoice gets paid. You’re in full control.

With the ability to toggle review requests on or off directly from the client profile, job, visit, or invoice, you’ll never send a review request to a client that is not the right fit.

💡 See what’s working and double down on it

Updated review insights will help you monitor trends in ratings, volume, and response rates—all of which are key drivers of local SEO and new business.

Your competition isn’t slowing down—and now, you don’t have to guess how you stack up. With the competitor analysis on Reviews, you get a snapshot of how your business compares to local competitors.

It is easier than ever to track the performance of your marketing campaigns over time. Plus, you can sort and search through your past efforts to easily spot your biggest wins.

Get inspired by smarter campaign templates that are aligned to your goals, helping you build better campaigns based on what’s worked before.

⚡️ Spend less time doing and more time growing

Referral reminders go out automatically after a job is closed, so your satisfied clients keep bringing in new ones without you having to follow up.

Campaign duplication lets you clone your top-performing emails in just a couple of clicks—no rebuilding from scratch.

Ready to Grow with Marketing Suite?

This season, let your marketing pull its weight.
You focus on the work—Marketing Suite handles the rest.

Get started with Marketing Suite

To learn more about Marketing Suite, visit our Help Center.

Marketing Suite is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Integrations
Know why your reps are losing sales, and how to fix it with Sales Ask
Shared by Ashley • May 01, 2025

When your team is out in the field, it’s hard to know how client meetings are going. Sales Ask and Jobber solve that by recording in-person meetings and giving you instant access to sales conversations and insights.

After each meeting, you’ll get a full transcript, a score showing how well your sales process was followed, and AI-driven coaching tips - directly in Jobber.

You’ll have everything you need to virtually coach your team and close more jobs.

Get started

Available on a Connect or higher plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Elevate your website with a custom domain & image gallery
Shared by Kim • April 21, 2025

Jobber makes it easy to quickly launch a website with all the essentials your customers expect from a professional business. Now, you can add an extra layer of polish to your website—and promote it with pride with a custom domain.

What’s new:

Add a custom domain to your website (ex. www.yourbusinessname.com). You can connect a custom domain you already own, or purchase a new one through Jobber’s partners at a discount.
Show off your work with a professional image gallery.

Get started

To learn more about Websites, visit our Help Center.

Available on a Core or higher plan.

Integrations
Simplify how your team manages customer calls with OpenPhone
Shared by Ashley • April 10, 2025

OpenPhone is a collaborative phone system that helps your team stay on top of calls, texts, and contacts - all in one simple app that works across your devices. Every time you chat with a client or lead, OpenPhone creates an AI-powered summary so you don’t have to jot down notes or worry about missing details.

Now with our new OpenPhone integration, those summaries automatically sync to Jobber. You’ll see past conversations linked to the right clients and requests, so it’s easy to pick up where you left off, stay organized, and deliver a 5-star customer experience they’ll rave about.

Get started

Available on a Core or higher plan.

Desktop App
New Feature
Your business health metrics in an all NEW dashboard
Shared by Paige • March 24, 2025

The new insights dashboard gives you a quick, at-a-glance view of the numbers that matter most—like revenue trends, lead conversion rates, and job capacity. No more jumping between reports to understand how your business is doing. Want to dive deeper? Just click ‘View report’ on any graph to open the corresponding report.

You’ll find the insights dashboard under the new Insights tab in the side navigation. All your usual reports are available in the Reports tab.

Learn more about the insights dashboard in our Help Center.

The insights dashboard is available on all plans.

The revenue by lead source chart—available on the insights dashboard—shows the total invoiced revenue tied to lead sources like Google, Facebook, and Instagram over the last 90 days. It gives you a quick, visual snapshot of what’s driving results.

For a deeper dive, use the lead source report to track the number of leads and revenue from each source over time. This makes it easier to know where to focus your marketing budget and effort.

To get started tracking lead sources and make smarter marketing decisions, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
More control over which users can access Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • July 11, 2025

Marketing Suite users can control which users can access the products in Marketing Suite. Whether you want to give access to a marketing agency or a relative who helps with your marketing, you're able to do so without needing to give them admin permissions.

Get started with Marketing Suite

To learn more about Marketing Suite, visit our Help Center.

Marketing Suite is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Easier communication with property contacts
Shared by Kim • May 30, 2025

Communicating with building managers, tenants, and other property-specific contacts just got simpler—especially for clients with multiple properties.

You can now assign contacts directly to individual properties in Jobber and control exactly which communications they receive. For example, you may want them to receive visit reminders but not invoices. Within the next few weeks, this will also include on-my-way texts.

Stay organized and keep everyone in the loop—without the hassle.

Get started

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Available on all plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Add multiple client contacts—and send the right info to the right people
Shared by Kim • May 15, 2025

Most jobs require contact with multiple people—like landlords, tenants, additional residents, or accounts payable.

Now you can add multiple contacts under a single client profile and control exactly which communications each one receives—like quotes, visit reminders, and final invoices.

That means less manual emailing, fewer mix-ups, and more time back in your day. Jobber keeps everyone in the loop automatically.

Get started

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Available on all plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get ready to win big this season with Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • May 14, 2025

Marketing Suite just got a serious upgrade to help you grow your business this season—not your admin time.

🛠️ Tailor your tools to work the way you do

Your timing matters. Send review requests at the moment that makes the most sense—after a visit, once a job is closed, or when an invoice gets paid. You’re in full control.

With the ability to toggle review requests on or off directly from the client profile, job, visit, or invoice, you’ll never send a review request to a client that is not the right fit.

💡 See what’s working and double down on it

Updated review insights will help you monitor trends in ratings, volume, and response rates—all of which are key drivers of local SEO and new business.

It is easier than ever to track the performance of your marketing campaigns over time. Plus, you can sort and search through your past efforts to easily spot your biggest wins.

Get inspired by smarter campaign templates that are aligned to your goals, helping you build better campaigns based on what’s worked before.

⚡️ Spend less time doing and more time growing

Referral reminders go out automatically after a job is closed, so your satisfied clients keep bringing in new ones without you having to follow up.

Campaign duplication lets you clone your top-performing emails in just a couple of clicks—no rebuilding from scratch.

Ready to Grow with Marketing Suite?

This season, let your marketing pull its weight.
You focus on the work—Marketing Suite handles the rest.

Integrations
Know why your reps are losing sales, and how to fix it with Sales Ask
Shared by Ashley • May 01, 2025

When your team is out in the field, it’s hard to know how client meetings are going. Sales Ask and Jobber solve that by recording in-person meetings and giving you instant access to sales conversations and insights.

After each meeting, you’ll get a full transcript, a score showing how well your sales process was followed, and AI-driven coaching tips - directly in Jobber.

You’ll have everything you need to virtually coach your team and close more jobs.

Get started

Available on a Connect or higher plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Elevate your website with a custom domain & image gallery
Shared by Kim • April 21, 2025

Jobber makes it easy to quickly launch a website with all the essentials your customers expect from a professional business. Now, you can add an extra layer of polish to your website—and promote it with pride with a custom domain.

Integrations
Simplify how your team manages customer calls with OpenPhone
Shared by Ashley • April 10, 2025

OpenPhone is a collaborative phone system that helps your team stay on top of calls, texts, and contacts - all in one simple app that works across your devices. Every time you chat with a client or lead, OpenPhone creates an AI-powered summary so you don’t have to jot down notes or worry about missing details.

Now with our new OpenPhone integration, those summaries automatically sync to Jobber. You’ll see past conversations linked to the right clients and requests, so it’s easy to pick up where you left off, stay organized, and deliver a 5-star customer experience they’ll rave about.

Get started

Available on a Core or higher plan.

Desktop App
New Feature
Your business health metrics in an all NEW dashboard
Shared by Paige • March 24, 2025

The new insights dashboard gives you a quick, at-a-glance view of the numbers that matter most—like revenue trends, lead conversion rates, and job capacity. No more jumping between reports to understand how your business is doing. Want to dive deeper? Just click ‘View report’ on any graph to open the corresponding report.

You’ll find the insights dashboard under the new Insights tab in the side navigation. All your usual reports are available in the Reports tab.

Learn more about the insights dashboard in our Help Center.

The insights dashboard is available on all plans.

## 💡 See what’s working and double down on it

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** August 05, 2025

Use the “Required” toggle on job form questions to make sure your team captures the most important details, every time. This improves job visibility and reduces delays caused by missing information.
​

With required questions on job forms, admins can ensure critical info is filled out before a visit is completed. Field workers see a progress bar as they go and are prompted to finish any missing responses before moving on.
​

If a visit is closed with unanswered required questions, field staff will be guided to complete them, and admins will be notified right away through the activity feed and Home page of Jobber. This helps everyone stay on the same page, reduces back-and-forth, and keeps work moving smoothly.
​

To learn more about required questions on job forms, visit our Help Center.

Marketing Suite just got a serious upgrade to help you grow your business this season—not your admin time.

Get inspired by smarter campaign templates that are aligned to your goals, helping you build better campaigns based on what’s worked before.

⚡️ Spend less time doing and more time growing

Referral reminders go out automatically after a job is closed, so your satisfied clients keep bringing in new ones without you having to follow up.

Campaign duplication lets you clone your top-performing emails in just a couple of clicks—no rebuilding from scratch.

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/89309-elevate-your-website-with-a-custom-domain-image-gallery

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** August 05, 2025

Use the “Required” toggle on job form questions to make sure your team captures the most important details, every time. This improves job visibility and reduces delays caused by missing information.
​

With required questions on job forms, admins can ensure critical info is filled out before a visit is completed. Field workers see a progress bar as they go and are prompted to finish any missing responses before moving on.
​

If a visit is closed with unanswered required questions, field staff will be guided to complete them, and admins will be notified right away through the activity feed and Home page of Jobber. This helps everyone stay on the same page, reduces back-and-forth, and keeps work moving smoothly.
​

To learn more about required questions on job forms, visit our Help Center.

## Monitor your vehicle’s real-time location for effortless dispatching with Force Fleet Tracking

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/86647-monitor-your-vehicle-s-real-time-location-for-effortless-dispatching-with-force-fleet-tracking

**Shared by:** Ashley

**Date:** March 20, 2025

Force Fleet Tracking helps you track, monitor, and protect your vehicles with live GPS vehicle location tracking, vehicle health monitoring, dashcam video recording, and more.

Our new integration with Force Fleet Tracking lets you track live vehicle locations directly within Jobber alongside upcoming jobs for faster, more efficient dispatching. You can also access essential vehicle data like speed, fuel level, and battery status to better control vehicle maintenance costs directly in Jobber!

Get started

Available in the United States only on a Connect plan or higher.

Desktop App
New Feature
Win more clients over the competition with advanced quote customization
Shared by Cam • March 13, 2025

Quotes are more than just numbers on a page—they create a strong first impression and significantly influence your customer’s decision.

With advanced quote customization, you can send customizable, detailed quotes that showcase your expertise with stunning visuals and glowing reviews. Plus, use templates for your most frequently offered services to respond to customers faster.

Unlock new ways to customize your quote:

Introduction: Capture attention instantly with an eye-catching header image and a project overview.
Image gallery: Set clear expectations by showcasing images of your past and proposed work.
Attachments: Drive clarity and transparency by including files like contracts, warranties, designs, and more.
Reviews: Build trust and credibility by automatically showcasing your top reviews with Jobber Reviews.

Create a custom quote

For more information, please visit our Help Center.

Know which clients have left you a Google review, right from their profile
Shared by Anna • February 21, 2025

With Reviews, you can automate Google review requests to your clients. Desktop App
New Feature
Track your employees' output with the team productivity report
Shared by Paige • January 20, 2025

The new team productivity report allows you to track your fieldworkers’ productive output and get insight into how each employee contributes to your business.

The report breaks down visits scheduled, revenue associated with those jobs, time tracked on jobs, and general time tracked per employee. Plus, with a calculated productivity metric (revenue/job time tracked), you can easily identify your most productive employees, empowering you to recognize top performers, provide targeted coaching, and optimize team efficiency.

For more information on the team productivity report, please visit our Help Center

The team productivity report is available on the Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get detailed information about where leads are coming from with automated tracking
Shared by Anna • January 16, 2025

When a lead comes through your request form or online booking, Jobber will automatically record any UTM tags from the URL. If there is a UTM source tag, it will automatically become the lead source on the client's profile and be visible on your marketing insights dashboard. All other UTM tags will be recorded in the new client lead source report.

The client lead source report provides more insight into where your leads have come from and information on their respective quotes, jobs, and invoices. This report helps you understand which channels or campaigns drive the most revenue for your business. By leveraging these insights, you can then make more informed decisions about your marketing spend and strategy.

For more information on lead sources, please visit our Help Center.

The client lead source report is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Integrations
Win more jobs with effortless lead syncing between Angi and Jobber
Shared by Ashley • January 14, 2025

Angi connects your business with the largest homeowner network, helping you get discovered faster and connect with homeowners looking for your expertise.

With the new Angi integration, all job requests are automatically synced to Jobber, giving you everything you need to respond to leads quickly. Jobber ensures your leads are matched to existing clients, keeping your client list accurate and duplicate-free.

No more wasting time sorting through records or juggling systems - Angi and Jobber work together to help you manage leads, win more jobs, and grow your business with ease.

Get started

Available on Core, Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Simplify inventory tracking with instant access to materials in Jobber with Ply
Shared by Ashley • January 09, 2025

Ply is an inventory management software that simplifies inventory sourcing, purchasing, and management for contractors.

With the integration between Ply and Jobber, take the guesswork out of inventory management. Instantly access pricing, stock, and inventory details directly in Jobber, and reserve materials automatically when you book a job. Real-time syncing ensures material details for each job stay accurate, saving you time and reducing errors.

Get started

Available on Core, Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Key metrics help you track performance of requests
Shared by Paige • December 10, 2024

The Requests page now has two key metrics to help you understand your business health at a glance. You'll see the number of new requests in the past 30 days and a conversion rate of how successfully requests are converted into quotes or jobs. Trends arrows for each metric help you gauge growth or decline from the previous time period.

These metrics make it easier to see how well you capture leads and turn them into opportunities without digging into detailed reports.

To learn more about the Requests page, please visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Convert more quotes with automated email campaigns
Shared by Anna • December 10, 2024

Increase your quote conversion rate by using Campaigns to follow up on pending quotes. The automated “Close on pending quotes” campaign template lets you create a more professional-looking follow-up email to help increase your chances of landing that work.

You can set up as many of these automated campaigns as you'd like. Just be sure your timing complements any quote follow-ups you may already be sending.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Campaigns is also included in Marketing Suite.

## Win more clients over the competition with advanced quote customization

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/86050-win-more-clients-over-the-competition-with-advanced-quote-customization

**Shared by:** Ashley

**Date:** March 20, 2025

Force Fleet Tracking helps you track, monitor, and protect your vehicles with live GPS vehicle location tracking, vehicle health monitoring, dashcam video recording, and more.

Our new integration with Force Fleet Tracking lets you track live vehicle locations directly within Jobber alongside upcoming jobs for faster, more efficient dispatching. You can also access essential vehicle data like speed, fuel level, and battery status to better control vehicle maintenance costs directly in Jobber!

Get started

Available in the United States only on a Connect plan or higher.

Desktop App
New Feature
Win more clients over the competition with advanced quote customization
Shared by Cam • March 13, 2025

Quotes are more than just numbers on a page—they create a strong first impression and significantly influence your customer’s decision.

With advanced quote customization, you can send customizable, detailed quotes that showcase your expertise with stunning visuals and glowing reviews. Plus, use templates for your most frequently offered services to respond to customers faster.

Unlock new ways to customize your quote:

Introduction: Capture attention instantly with an eye-catching header image and a project overview.
Image gallery: Set clear expectations by showcasing images of your past and proposed work.
Attachments: Drive clarity and transparency by including files like contracts, warranties, designs, and more.
Reviews: Build trust and credibility by automatically showcasing your top reviews with Jobber Reviews.

Create a custom quote

For more information, please visit our Help Center.

Advanced quote customization is available on Grow and Plus plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Know which clients have left you a Google review, right from their profile
Shared by Anna • February 21, 2025

With Reviews, you can automate Google review requests to your clients. Once a client leaves a review, if their Google profile matches a client name in Jobber, the review will be linked to their profile. Since that client has already left a review, Jobber won't ask them for a review again and toggle off the 'Ask for review' setting.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as part of the Marketing Suite add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Desktop App
New Feature
Save hours on quote creation with quote templates
Shared by Cam • January 30, 2025

Quote templates help simplify quoting for your most popular services. You can apply templates when creating new quotes and converting requests into quotes. Not only will this save you hours, but it will also help you respond to leads faster and minimize errors from manual entry.

Get started

Available in the United States only on a Connect plan or higher.

Desktop App
New Feature
Win more clients over the competition with advanced quote customization
Shared by Cam • March 13, 2025

Quotes are more than just numbers on a page—they create a strong first impression and significantly influence your customer’s decision.

With advanced quote customization, you can send customizable, detailed quotes that showcase your expertise with stunning visuals and glowing reviews. Plus, use templates for your most frequently offered services to respond to customers faster.

Unlock new ways to customize your quote:

Introduction: Capture attention instantly with an eye-catching header image and a project overview.
Image gallery: Set clear expectations by showcasing images of your past and proposed work.
Attachments: Drive clarity and transparency by including files like contracts, warranties, designs, and more.
Reviews: Build trust and credibility by automatically showcasing your top reviews with Jobber Reviews.

Create a custom quote

For more information, please visit our Help Center.

Advanced quote customization is available on Grow and Plus plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Know which clients have left you a Google review, right from their profile
Shared by Anna • February 21, 2025

With Reviews, you can automate Google review requests to your clients. Once a client leaves a review, if their Google profile matches a client name in Jobber, the review will be linked to their profile. Since that client has already left a review, Jobber won't ask them for a review again and toggle off the 'Ask for review' setting.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as part of the Marketing Suite add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Desktop App
New Feature
Save hours on quote creation with quote templates
Shared by Cam • January 30, 2025

We’ve heard from home service businesses like yours that being able to create quotes more efficiently is key to winning work. That’s why we're introducing quote templates—a game-changer for saving time and reducing repetitive work.

Quote templates help simplify quoting for your most popular services. You can apply templates when creating new quotes and converting requests into quotes. Not only will this save you hours, but it will also help you respond to leads faster and minimize errors from manual entry.

Get started now and see how much time it saves you! Go to your Quotes page and click the "Templates" button.

Go to your Quotes page

For more information, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
New Feature
Track your employees' output with the team productivity report
Shared by Paige • January 20, 2025

The new team productivity report allows you to track your fieldworkers’ productive output and get insight into how each employee contributes to your business.

The report breaks down visits scheduled, revenue associated with those jobs, time tracked on jobs, and general time tracked per employee. Plus, with a calculated productivity metric (revenue/job time tracked), you can easily identify your most productive employees, empowering you to recognize top performers, provide targeted coaching, and optimize team efficiency.

For more information on the team productivity report, please visit our Help Center

The team productivity report is available on the Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get detailed information about where leads are coming from with automated tracking
Shared by Anna • January 16, 2025

When a lead comes through your request form or online booking, Jobber will automatically record any UTM tags from the URL. If there is a UTM source tag, it will automatically become the lead source on the client's profile and be visible on your marketing insights dashboard. All other UTM tags will be recorded in the new client lead source report.

The client lead source report provides more insight into where your leads have come from and information on their respective quotes, jobs, and invoices. This report helps you understand which channels or campaigns drive the most revenue for your business. By leveraging these insights, you can then make more informed decisions about your marketing spend and strategy.

For more information on lead sources, please visit our Help Center.

The client lead source report is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Integrations
Win more jobs with effortless lead syncing between Angi and Jobber
Shared by Ashley • January 14, 2025

Angi connects your business with the largest homeowner network, helping you get discovered faster and connect with homeowners looking for your expertise.

With the new Angi integration, all job requests are automatically synced to Jobber, giving you everything you need to respond to leads quickly. Jobber ensures your leads are matched to existing clients, keeping your client list accurate and duplicate-free.

No more wasting time sorting through records or juggling systems - Angi and Jobber work together to help you manage leads, win more jobs, and grow your business with ease.

Get started

Available on Core, Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Simplify inventory tracking with instant access to materials in Jobber with Ply
Shared by Ashley • January 09, 2025

Ply is an inventory management software that simplifies inventory sourcing, purchasing, and management for contractors.

With the integration between Ply and Jobber, take the guesswork out of inventory management. Instantly access pricing, stock, and inventory details directly in Jobber, and reserve materials automatically when you book a job. Real-time syncing ensures material details for each job stay accurate, saving you time and reducing errors.

Get started

Available on Core, Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Key metrics help you track performance of requests
Shared by Paige • December 10, 2024

The Requests page now has two key metrics to help you understand your business health at a glance. You'll see the number of new requests in the past 30 days and a conversion rate of how successfully requests are converted into quotes or jobs. Trends arrows for each metric help you gauge growth or decline from the previous time period.

These metrics make it easier to see how well you capture leads and turn them into opportunities without digging into detailed reports.

To learn more about the Requests page, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Convert more quotes with automated email campaigns
Shared by Anna • December 10, 2024

Increase your quote conversion rate by using Campaigns to follow up on pending quotes. The automated “Close on pending quotes” campaign template lets you create a more professional-looking follow-up email to help increase your chances of landing that work.

You can set up as many of these automated campaigns as you'd like. Just be sure your timing complements any quote follow-ups you may already be sending.

Get started with Campaigns

No more wasting time sorting through records or juggling systems - Angi and Jobber work together to help you manage leads, win more jobs, and grow your business with ease.

Get started

Available on Core, Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Simplify inventory tracking with instant access to materials in Jobber with Ply
Shared by Ashley • January 09, 2025

Ply is an inventory management software that simplifies inventory sourcing, purchasing, and management for contractors.

With the integration between Ply and Jobber, take the guesswork out of inventory management. Instantly access pricing, stock, and inventory details directly in Jobber, and reserve materials automatically when you book a job. Real-time syncing ensures material details for each job stay accurate, saving you time and reducing errors.

Get started

Available on Core, Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Key metrics help you track performance of requests
Shared by Paige • December 10, 2024

The Requests page now has two key metrics to help you understand your business health at a glance. You'll see the number of new requests in the past 30 days and a conversion rate of how successfully requests are converted into quotes or jobs. Trends arrows for each metric help you gauge growth or decline from the previous time period.

These metrics make it easier to see how well you capture leads and turn them into opportunities without digging into detailed reports.

To learn more about the Requests page, please visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Convert more quotes with automated email campaigns
Shared by Anna • December 10, 2024

Increase your quote conversion rate by using Campaigns to follow up on pending quotes. The automated “Close on pending quotes” campaign template lets you create a more professional-looking follow-up email to help increase your chances of landing that work.

You can set up as many of these automated campaigns as you'd like. Just be sure your timing complements any quote follow-ups you may already be sending.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Campaigns is also included in Marketing Suite.

## Track your business health from the Jobber app

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/76944-track-your-business-health-from-the-jobber-app

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** December 04, 2024

Stay on top of your business performance using the new business health dashboard on the mobile app. Now, service pros can assess critical metrics like new clients, quote conversion rates, job value, and invoice total—all while on the go.

The dashboard displays data and trend arrows to show whether key metrics have improved or declined since the previous period so you can quickly spot opportunities or address issues. Whether you're in the field, in a work vehicle between jobs, or at the office, you can track business health instantly and easily from the Jobber app.

For more information on the business health dashboard on the mobile app, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
New Feature
Save time and tailor Jobber to your needs with the custom automation builder
Shared by Paige • November 29, 2024

The new custom automation builder helps you save time by removing manual administrative tasks that keep work moving. Build and set your automations once, and Jobber will handle the rest.

With advanced customization capabilities, you can specify the timing, triggers, and conditional statements that set off actions. You can automate sending targeted texts and emails to ensure clients respond to your quotes and invoices, tag clients with custom tags for better organization, and update quote statuses to keep your work in order.

For more information on the custom automation builder please visit our Help Center.

The custom automation builder is available on the Plus plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Customize your lead sources to more accurately track where leads are coming from
Shared by Anna • November 26, 2024

With the lead source field on the client profile, you can track where your customers are coming from. There is a list to get you started, but you can also save your own custom lead sources. Plus, coming soon—if you use UTM tags on your request form or online booking link, Jobber will automatically record the source and campaign details to save you time and give you even deeper insights!

As you start tracking lead sources over time, you'll see what your top performing sources are on your marketing dashboard. You can also view and export this data from the client contact info report.

To learn more about how lead attribution works, visit our Help Center.

Lead attribution is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Let your clients know you're thinking of them this holiday season
Shared by Anna • November 21, 2024

Stay connected with your clients over the holidays with Campaigns. Using the “Holidays” template, you can send holiday greetings to your clients to let them know you're thinking of them. These campaigns can also be a good opportunity to communicate holiday hours and closures or promote relevant offers.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Campaigns is also included in Marketing Suite.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get more insight into your client's referral activity with Referrals
Shared by Anna • November 20, 2024

With Referrals, you can get a more detailed look into a client's activity with your referral program. You can see which leads your client referred, which leads resulted in a job, and the associated revenue of that job. Additionally, you can see how many credits have been earned, are pending or applied, and their credit balance.

Get started with Referrals

To learn more about Referrals, visit our Help Center.

Referrals is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. It is also included as part of the Marketing Suite.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get paid faster with partial payments on invoices in Client Hub
C
Shared by Cayman • November 20, 2024

You can now enable partial payments on invoices, allowing clients to make multiple payments through Client Hub.

To enable this feature, go to Invoice Payment Settings below the invoice total when creating an invoice and toggle on partial payments. Clients can then make smaller payments over time and split payments across multiple methods—helping you get paid faster and smoothing out your cash flow.

For more details on partial payments, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control how review follow-ups are sent to your customers
Shared by Anna • October 31, 2024

With Reviews, you can customize if and when review follow-ups are sent to your customers. You can adjust how many days after the initial request you'd like to send a follow-up to your customers. You can also choose to turn off follow-ups altogether if you prefer.

To manage your follow-up preferences, click 'Manage' from the Reviews dashboard and select the follow-up you want to customize. From there, you can adjust the timing or turn it off by using the toggle.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom. It is also included as part of the Marketing Suite.

Desktop App
New Feature
Get discovered online with a website that's designed to get more leads
Shared by Anna • October 24, 2024

Got a minute? That's all you need to create and publish a personalized, professional website for your business. You'll save time and money because Jobber fully hosts your website and comes with a free subdomain you can use immediately.

Your website comes out of the box with all the essentials you need:

Key business information: Tell customers about your business by including your service area, the services you offer, and any frequently asked questions
Lead capture: Your request form is included so you can capture all the details you need to convert inquiries into quotes faster
Social proof: Showcase your customer reviews from Google to instill confidence in your business
Reporting: Monitor your lead conversion by tracking your website visitors and requests over time
Coming soon: Show customers the quality of your work by showcasing a gallery of your previous work

Get started

To learn more, please visit our Help Center.

This feature is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Visualize issued and paid invoices with a new chart on the invoices report
Shared by Paige • October 22, 2024

At the top of the invoices report, you'll now find a chart showing the total dollar value of invoices issued and paid. The date range of this chart automatically adjusts based on your selected date range in the report.

For a deeper dive, hover over each bar to see a breakdown of your invoice data and easily spot if you have invoices with payment outstanding. These new visuals provide valuable insights into your cash flow, allowing you to identify gaps in payment quickly.

For more information on the invoices report, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
The new home design is here to stay!
Shared by Cam • October 03, 2024

Welcome to your new home! Know exactly how your business is performing in one glance and stay focused on the most important work at hand so you can keep your business and team on track.

Thanks to your feedback, we have made the following improvements:

We've brought back the requests, quotes, jobs, and invoice summaries so you can quickly identify areas that need attention
You can now view your daily appointments by employees or by visits to help you get a better pulse on your schedule
Track who owes you money and follow up with them more easily with the new recent overdue invoices section
Plus, performance improvements, enhanced insights, and more!

It doesn't stop there! Even more insights and improvements will be added in the future, so stay tuned!

Learn more
‹ Prev
