You can automate sending targeted texts and emails to ensure clients respond to your quotes and invoices, tag clients with custom tags for better organization, and update quote statuses to keep your work in order.

For more information on the custom automation builder please visit our Help Center.

The custom automation builder is available on the Plus plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Customize your lead sources to more accurately track where leads are coming from
Shared by Anna • November 26, 2024

With the lead source field on the client profile, you can track where your customers are coming from. There is a list to get you started, but you can also save your own custom lead sources. Plus, coming soon—if you use UTM tags on your request form or online booking link, Jobber will automatically record the source and campaign details to save you time and give you even deeper insights!

As you start tracking lead sources over time, you'll see what your top performing sources are on your marketing dashboard. You can also view and export this data from the client contact info report.

To learn more about how lead attribution works, visit our Help Center.

Lead attribution is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Let your clients know you're thinking of them this holiday season
Shared by Anna • November 21, 2024

Stay connected with your clients over the holidays with Campaigns. Using the “Holidays” template, you can send holiday greetings to your clients to let them know you're thinking of them. These campaigns can also be a good opportunity to communicate holiday hours and closures or promote relevant offers.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Campaigns is also included in Marketing Suite.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get more insight into your client's referral activity with Referrals
Shared by Anna • November 20, 2024

With Referrals, you can get a more detailed look into a client's activity with your referral program. You can see which leads your client referred, which leads resulted in a job, and the associated revenue of that job. Additionally, you can see how many credits have been earned, are pending or applied, and their credit balance.

Get started with Referrals

To learn more about Referrals, visit our Help Center.

Referrals is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. It is also included as part of the Marketing Suite.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get paid faster with partial payments on invoices in Client Hub
C
Shared by Cayman • November 20, 2024

You can now enable partial payments on invoices, allowing clients to make multiple payments through Client Hub.

To enable this feature, go to Invoice Payment Settings below the invoice total when creating an invoice and toggle on partial payments. Clients can then make smaller payments over time and split payments across multiple methods—helping you get paid faster and smoothing out your cash flow.

For more details on partial payments, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control how review follow-ups are sent to your customers
Shared by Anna • October 31, 2024

With Reviews, you can customize if and when review follow-ups are sent to your customers. You can adjust how many days after the initial request you'd like to send a follow-up to your customers. You can also choose to turn off follow-ups altogether if you prefer.

To manage your follow-up preferences, click 'Manage' from the Reviews dashboard and select the follow-up you want to customize. From there, you can adjust the timing or turn it off by using the toggle.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom. It is also included as part of the Marketing Suite.

Desktop App
New Feature
Get discovered online with a website that's designed to get more leads
Shared by Anna • October 24, 2024

Got a minute? That's all you need to create and publish a personalized, professional website for your business. You'll save time and money because Jobber fully hosts your website and comes with a free subdomain you can use immediately.

Your website comes out of the box with all the essentials you need:

Key business information: Tell customers about your business by including your service area, the services you offer, and any frequently asked questions
Lead capture: Your request form is included so you can capture all the details you need to convert inquiries into quotes faster
Social proof: Showcase your customer reviews from Google to instill confidence in your business
Reporting: Monitor your lead conversion by tracking your website visitors and requests over time
Coming soon: Show customers the quality of your work by showcasing a gallery of your previous work

Get started

To learn more, please visit our Help Center.

This feature is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Visualize issued and paid invoices with a new chart on the invoices report
Shared by Paige • October 22, 2024

At the top of the invoices report, you'll now find a chart showing the total dollar value of invoices issued and paid. The date range of this chart automatically adjusts based on your selected date range in the report.

For a deeper dive, hover over each bar to see a breakdown of your invoice data and easily spot if you have invoices with payment outstanding. These new visuals provide valuable insights into your cash flow, allowing you to identify gaps in payment quickly.

For more information on the invoices report, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
The new home design is here to stay!
Shared by Cam • October 03, 2024

Welcome to your new home! Know exactly how your business is performing in one glance and stay focused on the most important work at hand so you can keep your business and team on track.

You can now view your daily appointments by employees or by visits to help you get a better pulse on your schedule
Track who owes you money and follow up with them more easily with the new recent overdue invoices section
Plus, performance improvements, enhanced insights, and more!

Get discovered online with a website that's designed to get more leads
Shared by Anna • October 24, 2024

Got a minute? That's all you need to create and publish a personalized, professional website for your business. You'll save time and money because Jobber fully hosts your website and comes with a free subdomain you can use immediately.

Your website comes out of the box with all the essentials you need:

Key business information: Tell customers about your business by including your service area, the services you offer, and any frequently asked questions
Lead capture: Your request form is included so you can capture all the details you need to convert inquiries into quotes faster
Social proof: Showcase your customer reviews from Google to instill confidence in your business
Reporting: Monitor your lead conversion by tracking your website visitors and requests over time
Coming soon: Show customers the quality of your work by showcasing a gallery of your previous work

Get started

To learn more, please visit our Help Center.

This feature is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Visualize issued and paid invoices with a new chart on the invoices report
Shared by Paige • October 22, 2024

At the top of the invoices report, you'll now find a chart showing the total dollar value of invoices issued and paid. The date range of this chart automatically adjusts based on your selected date range in the report.

For a deeper dive, hover over each bar to see a breakdown of your invoice data and easily spot if you have invoices with payment outstanding. These new visuals provide valuable insights into your cash flow, allowing you to identify gaps in payment quickly.

For more information on the invoices report, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update

We've brought back the requests, quotes, jobs, and invoice summaries so you can quickly identify areas that need attention

Plus, performance improvements, enhanced insights, and more!

## The new home design is here to stay!

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/71700-the-new-home-design-is-here-to-stay

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** December 04, 2024

Stay on top of your business performance using the new business health dashboard on the mobile app. Now, service pros can assess critical metrics like new clients, quote conversion rates, job value, and invoice total—all while on the go.

The dashboard displays data and trend arrows to show whether key metrics have improved or declined since the previous period so you can quickly spot opportunities or address issues. Whether you're in the field, in a work vehicle between jobs, or at the office, you can track business health instantly and easily from the Jobber app.

For more information on the business health dashboard on the mobile app, please visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
New Feature
Save time and tailor Jobber to your needs with the custom automation builder
Shared by Paige • November 29, 2024

The new custom automation builder helps you save time by removing manual administrative tasks that keep work moving. Build and set your automations once, and Jobber will handle the rest.

With advanced customization capabilities, you can specify the timing, triggers, and conditional statements that set off actions. You can automate sending targeted texts and emails to ensure clients respond to your quotes and invoices, tag clients with custom tags for better organization, and update quote statuses to keep your work in order.

For more information on the custom automation builder please visit our Help Center.

The custom automation builder is available on the Plus plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Customize your lead sources to more accurately track where leads are coming from
Shared by Anna • November 26, 2024

With the lead source field on the client profile, you can track where your customers are coming from. There is a list to get you started, but you can also save your own custom lead sources. Plus, coming soon—if you use UTM tags on your request form or online booking link, Jobber will automatically record the source and campaign details to save you time and give you even deeper insights!

As you start tracking lead sources over time, you'll see what your top performing sources are on your marketing dashboard. You can also view and export this data from the client contact info report.

To learn more about how lead attribution works, visit our Help Center.

Lead attribution is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Let your clients know you're thinking of them this holiday season
Shared by Anna • November 21, 2024

Stay connected with your clients over the holidays with Campaigns. Using the “Holidays” template, you can send holiday greetings to your clients to let them know you're thinking of them. These campaigns can also be a good opportunity to communicate holiday hours and closures or promote relevant offers.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Campaigns is also included in Marketing Suite.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get more insight into your client's referral activity with Referrals
Shared by Anna • November 20, 2024

With Referrals, you can get a more detailed look into a client's activity with your referral program. You can see which leads your client referred, which leads resulted in a job, and the associated revenue of that job. Additionally, you can see how many credits have been earned, are pending or applied, and their credit balance.

Get started with Referrals

To learn more about Referrals, visit our Help Center.

Referrals is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. It is also included as part of the Marketing Suite.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get paid faster with partial payments on invoices in Client Hub
C
Shared by Cayman • November 20, 2024

You can now enable partial payments on invoices, allowing clients to make multiple payments through Client Hub.

To enable this feature, go to Invoice Payment Settings below the invoice total when creating an invoice and toggle on partial payments. Clients can then make smaller payments over time and split payments across multiple methods—helping you get paid faster and smoothing out your cash flow.

For more details on partial payments, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control how review follow-ups are sent to your customers
Shared by Anna • October 31, 2024

With Reviews, you can customize if and when review follow-ups are sent to your customers. You can adjust how many days after the initial request you'd like to send a follow-up to your customers. You can also choose to turn off follow-ups altogether if you prefer.

To manage your follow-up preferences, click 'Manage' from the Reviews dashboard and select the follow-up you want to customize. From there, you can adjust the timing or turn it off by using the toggle.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom. It is also included as part of the Marketing Suite.

**Shared by:** Paige

Business coaching: receive personalized guidance and recommendations.

Desktop App
New Feature
Meet the easier way to grow your business with Marketing Suite
Shared by Anna • September 30, 2024

When reputation and trust are everything, Jobber helps you build the recognition you deserve, stay top of mind for your top customers, and makes it easy for them to refer you hot leads.

Get Referrals, Reviews and Campaigns in one powerful package with Marketing Suite
🆕 Referrals fuels word of mouth by making it easy for customers to refer you, get their incentive, and return to you to use it.
Reviews makes it easy for customers to choose you over your competitors by getting you more 5-star reviews.
Campaigns helps you create, send, and track email campaigns that bring in more business and always keep you top of mind.

Unlock the full Marketing Suite

Each tool is also available separately.

Reviews is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
Feature Update
Desktop App
Turn lost leads into customers with automated email campaigns
Shared by Anna • September 12, 2024

Get more work from your customers and recover lost leads by using Campaigns to stay connected and drive new revenue opportunities. You can take it one step further by setting up fully-customizable automated campaigns that bring in new business 24/7.

The new automated “Win back lost leads” campaign template lets you automatically reach out to leads that you’ve sent a quote to, but weren’t able to work with. Pro tip: Offer a discount or special offer to make them consider you again. This gives you a chance to stay top of mind and convert your lost leads without the extra effort.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Track your salespeople’s performance with a new report
Shared by Paige • August 30, 2024

Now, you can assign a specific salesperson to quotes, jobs, and invoices, making it easier to track which team member closed the deal.

The salesperson performance report provides detailed insights, breaking down each salesperson's sent quotes, converted quotes, and conversion rate. This report helps you understand your team's sales impact, allowing you to recognize top performers and optimize your sales strategy.

For more information on tracking salespeople and the salesperson performance report, please visit our Help Center.

Salesperson attribution is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
New Feature
Welcome to the dark side!
Shared by Cam • August 26, 2024

After much feedback, we're thrilled to finally introduce dark mode! Dark mode helps reduce eye strain and lets you work more comfortably for longer periods of time. Moreover, it helps extend your device's battery life and lessens glare and reflections on your screen.

At this time, this setting is only available when accessing getjobber.com through a computer or mobile browser. Click the ⚙️ Gear icon to switch between light and dark mode. Your eyes will thank you!

Learn more
Feature Update
Desktop App
Save more time with automated email campaigns that work as hard as you do
Shared by Anna • August 22, 2024

With Campaigns, you can set-up emails that will automatically be sent to your customers once they meet certain conditions. This will make running campaigns more efficient because you can set it up once and then let it run 24/7 in the background—bringing in new business for you.

With the automated ‘Re-engage past clients’ template and the ability to include or exclude customers with specific client tags, who have had specific products/services (line items), or job types (one-off/recurring), there are many possibilities. Some examples of campaigns you could automate are...

General outreach to customers who haven't had work done in a while
Maintenance reminders to customers who had a specific type of job
Encouraging one-off clients to book recurring services

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Show customers you care by responding to their review in just 2 clicks
Shared by Anna • August 22, 2024

With Reviews, you can easily respond to your customers' reviews from Jobber by clicking ‘Generate response’. It will generate a unique response based on the content of the review. If needed, you can tweak the response or use the rewrite action before sending it off. Google favors businesses that respond to their reviews so be sure to show your customers that you appreciate their review!

Other updates to Reviews include the follow-up schedule changing to 3 and 5 days after the initial review request.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Integrations
Easily sync your data from Jobber to Xero for more automated accounting
Shared by Paige • August 22, 2024

You can now push customers, products & services, invoices, and payments to Xero. With a connection between your accounting and your operations management software, you control your entire business from one place. The integration can help you with:

Data syncing
Payments reconciliation
Client management
Inventory reporting
Filing taxes

Get started
Feature Update
Desktop App
Get richer insights from requests and online booking with Google Analytics
Shared by Anna • June 25, 2024

You can now connect your request form and online booking to Google Analytics 4 to gain richer insights, including your conversion rate.

When connecting your Jobber request or online booking form to Google Analytics, you will be prompted to add your Google Analytics 4 tracking code, so you will need to have that code handy as part of the set up.

To learn more about how to set this tracking up, visit our Help Center.

Requests is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
New quotes page features that help you save even more time
Shared by Cam • June 17, 2024

Keeping up with a large volume of quotes has been made simpler. With new bulk actions, admin users can select multiple quotes and delete or archive them all at once so it’s easier to stay organized.

We've also added quick actions for individual quotes so you can delete, send, or convert them into jobs without leaving the page. Simply hover or right-click on a specific quote to see the available actions.

Last but not least, we listened to your feedback and brought back the overview section! At a glance, you can quickly determine how many quotes need actioning based on their status.

These improvements were made in order to save you time so you can focus on more important aspects of your business.

See your improved quotes page

To learn more about bulk actions and quick actions, please visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Turn lost leads into customers with automated email campaigns
Shared by Anna • September 12, 2024

Get more work from your customers and recover lost leads by using Campaigns to stay connected and drive new revenue opportunities. You can take it one step further by setting up fully-customizable automated campaigns that bring in new business 24/7.

The new automated “Win back lost leads” campaign template lets you automatically reach out to leads that you’ve sent a quote to, but weren’t able to work with. Pro tip: Offer a discount or special offer to make them consider you again. This gives you a chance to stay top of mind and convert your lost leads without the extra effort.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Track your salespeople’s performance with a new report
Shared by Paige • August 30, 2024

Now, you can assign a specific salesperson to quotes, jobs, and invoices, making it easier to track which team member closed the deal.

The salesperson performance report provides detailed insights, breaking down each salesperson's sent quotes, converted quotes, and conversion rate. This report helps you understand your team's sales impact, allowing you to recognize top performers and optimize your sales strategy.

For more information on tracking salespeople and the salesperson performance report, please visit our Help Center.

Salesperson attribution is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
New Feature
Welcome to the dark side!
Shared by Cam • August 26, 2024

After much feedback, we're thrilled to finally introduce dark mode! Dark mode helps reduce eye strain and lets you work more comfortably for longer periods of time. Moreover, it helps extend your device's battery life and lessens glare and reflections on your screen.

At this time, this setting is only available when accessing getjobber.com through a computer or mobile browser. Click the ⚙️ Gear icon to switch between light and dark mode. Your eyes will thank you!

Learn more
Feature Update
Desktop App
Save more time with automated email campaigns that work as hard as you do
Shared by Anna • August 22, 2024

With Campaigns, you can set-up emails that will automatically be sent to your customers once they meet certain conditions. This will make running campaigns more efficient because you can set it up once and then let it run 24/7 in the background—bringing in new business for you.

With the automated ‘Re-engage past clients’ template and the ability to include or exclude customers with specific client tags, who have had specific products/services (line items), or job types (one-off/recurring), there are many possibilities. Some examples of campaigns you could automate are...

General outreach to customers who haven't had work done in a while
Maintenance reminders to customers who had a specific type of job
Encouraging one-off clients to book recurring services

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Show customers you care by responding to their review in just 2 clicks
Shared by Anna • August 22, 2024

With Reviews, you can easily respond to your customers' reviews from Jobber by clicking ‘Generate response’. It will generate a unique response based on the content of the review. If needed, you can tweak the response or use the rewrite action before sending it off. Google favors businesses that respond to their reviews so be sure to show your customers that you appreciate their review!

Other updates to Reviews include the follow-up schedule changing to 3 and 5 days after the initial review request.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Integrations
Easily sync your data from Jobber to Xero for more automated accounting
Shared by Paige • August 22, 2024

You can now push customers, products & services, invoices, and payments to Xero. With a connection between your accounting and your operations management software, you control your entire business from one place. The integration can help you with:

Data syncing
Payments reconciliation
Client management
Inventory reporting
Filing taxes

Get started
Feature Update
Desktop App
Get richer insights from requests and online booking with Google Analytics
Shared by Anna • June 25, 2024

You can now connect your request form and online booking to Google Analytics 4 to gain richer insights, including your conversion rate.

When connecting your Jobber request or online booking form to Google Analytics, you will be prompted to add your Google Analytics 4 tracking code, so you will need to have that code handy as part of the set up.

To learn more about how to set this tracking up, visit our Help Center.

Requests is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
New quotes page features that help you save even more time
Shared by Cam • June 17, 2024

Keeping up with a large volume of quotes has been made simpler. With new bulk actions, admin users can select multiple quotes and delete or archive them all at once so it’s easier to stay organized.

We've also added quick actions for individual quotes so you can delete, send, or convert them into jobs without leaving the page. Simply hover or right-click on a specific quote to see the available actions.

Last but not least, we listened to your feedback and brought back the overview section! At a glance, you can quickly determine how many quotes need actioning based on their status.

These improvements were made in order to save you time so you can focus on more important aspects of your business.

See your improved quotes page

To learn more about bulk actions and quick actions, please visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Save more time with automated email campaigns that work as hard as you do
Shared by Anna • August 22, 2024

With Campaigns, you can set-up emails that will automatically be sent to your customers once they meet certain conditions. This will make running campaigns more efficient because you can set it up once and then let it run 24/7 in the background—bringing in new business for you.

With the automated ‘Re-engage past clients’ template and the ability to include or exclude customers with specific client tags, who have had specific products/services (line items), or job types (one-off/recurring), there are many possibilities. Some examples of campaigns you could automate are...

General outreach to customers who haven't had work done in a while
Maintenance reminders to customers who had a specific type of job
Encouraging one-off clients to book recurring services

Get started with Campaigns

New quotes page features that help you save even more time

## New Zapier actions & triggers on version 3.0.0—update today!

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/53553-new-zapier-actions-triggers-on-version-3-0-0-update-today

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** June 13, 2024

A new version of the Jobber <> Zapier integration is now available! This edition introduces 8 new triggers and actions, allowing you to automate more of your routine tasks in Jobber or other tools.

New triggers

Client updated
New job created
Job updated
Quote sent
Invoice updated

New actions

Create job
Add tag to client
Add note to request

Note: Existing zaps will need to be updated to version 3.0.0, while any new zaps will automatically be on the new version.

Click here to update your zaps or create new ones to keep business running smoothly.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Partial or full refunds: it's your choice!
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2024

Sometimes situations come up where you need to issue a refund to a client. It happens! Jobber Payments users can now issue partial refunds for an invoice or deposit.

With this update, you have the flexibility to choose the exact amount you’d like to refund, including tips. Once the refund is issued, your client’s billing history box will be updated, giving you a full picture of all their payment records. You save time, and your clients stay happy.

To learn more about how to issue a refund with Jobber Payments, visit our Help Center.

Jobber Payments is available in the UK, United States, and Canada.

Desktop App
Visualize conversion rates with new charts on the quotes report
Shared by Paige • May 27, 2024

New data charts on the quotes report make it easy to see how your quotes are performing at a glance. You can now easily track your quote conversion rate and the dollar value of quotes sent and converted over the last 6 months.

These new visual tools provide valuable insights into your conversion trends and quote pipeline performance so you stay informed on the health of your business.

For more information on the quotes report, please visit our Help Center.

New and improved navigation on the mobile app

Users with two-way text messaging can now view messages through the Home view. Plus, the new More tab gives you quicker access to your Apps & Integrations, Jobber Payments, Jobber Money, Settings️ ⚙️ and more, all in one place.

With Campaigns, you can view a detailed report that outlines your email campaign's performance. See how your campaign did at the highest level with your open rate, click rate, revenue, and unsubscribe rate. Or, you can dive deeper into the data to see which customers opened or clicked on your campaign, unsubscribed from future marketing campaigns, or had a job created with a link to that specific job. Then, utilize this data to inform your future campaigns to ensure you're maximizing your success.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Easily respond to your reviews from the Reviews dashboard
Shared by Anna • May 06, 2024

From the Reviews dashboard, you can now respond to your customers' reviews without ever leaving Jobber. It's important to respond to your reviews because it shows that you value your customers and their feedback. Plus, responding to reviews is one of the ways you'll get a boost from Google in your local search results. Showing higher up in the search results means your business gets more visibility and attracts more customers.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Keep your jobs on track with the new jobs page
Shared by Cam • April 23, 2024

The jobs page has been redesigned to make it easier to find the information you need. See insights into your recent and upcoming visits so you can assess performance and plan your workload effectively. Additionally, you'll get improved filtering, more sorting options, and a wider view of your job details.

Job insights are now included in the one-off jobs report

Your revenue and cost trends can now be accessed through the one-off jobs report. Get a clear picture of your key revenue metrics alongside your detailed report so you can track your progress over time and make more informed decisions about your business.

## Partial or full refunds: it's your choice!

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/52378-partial-or-full-refunds-it-s-your-choice

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** June 13, 2024

A new version of the Jobber <> Zapier integration is now available! This edition introduces 8 new triggers and actions, allowing you to automate more of your routine tasks in Jobber or other tools.

New triggers

Client updated
New job created
Job updated
Quote sent
Invoice updated

New actions

Create job
Add tag to client
Add note to request

Feature Update
Desktop App
Partial or full refunds: it's your choice!
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2024

Sometimes situations come up where you need to issue a refund to a client. It happens! Jobber Payments users can now issue partial refunds for an invoice or deposit.

With this update, you have the flexibility to choose the exact amount you’d like to refund, including tips. Once the refund is issued, your client’s billing history box will be updated, giving you a full picture of all their payment records. You save time, and your clients stay happy.

To learn more about how to issue a refund with Jobber Payments, visit our Help Center.

Jobber Payments is available in the UK, United States, and Canada.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Visualize conversion rates with new charts on the quotes report
Shared by Paige • May 27, 2024

New data charts on the quotes report make it easy to see how your quotes are performing at a glance. You can now easily track your quote conversion rate and the dollar value of quotes sent and converted over the last 6 months.

These new visual tools provide valuable insights into your conversion trends and quote pipeline performance so you stay informed on the health of your business.

For more information on the quotes report, please visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Mobile App
New and improved navigation on the mobile app

Desktop App

This button connects to your online booking page so customers can book a time with you that works in both of your schedules without all the back and forth.

To learn more about connecting your online booking to Google, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Easily analyze your email campaign performance with in-depth reporting
Shared by Anna • May 13, 2024

With Campaigns, you can view a detailed report that outlines your email campaign's performance. See how your campaign did at the highest level with your open rate, click rate, revenue, and unsubscribe rate. Or, you can dive deeper into the data to see which customers opened or clicked on your campaign, unsubscribed from future marketing campaigns, or had a job created with a link to that specific job. Then, utilize this data to inform your future campaigns to ensure you're maximizing your success.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Easily respond to your reviews from the Reviews dashboard
Shared by Anna • May 06, 2024

From the Reviews dashboard, you can now respond to your customers' reviews without ever leaving Jobber. It's important to respond to your reviews because it shows that you value your customers and their feedback. Plus, responding to reviews is one of the ways you'll get a boost from Google in your local search results. Showing higher up in the search results means your business gets more visibility and attracts more customers.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Desktop App

Desktop App

## Create and send your email campaigns with more robust options

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/48707-create-and-send-your-email-campaigns-with-more-robust-options

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** April 17, 2024

Easily schedule your email campaigns to send later

With Campaigns, you can draft your email when it's convenient for you and schedule it to send at an optimal day and time for your customers. Once a campaign is scheduled, you will see a 'Scheduled' status in your dashboard. You can hover over the campaign to 'Pause and edit' the campaign or 'Send now' if you want to override the scheduled date and time.

Customize your email content more effectively

When creating your email content, you can now apply different heading styles. This will give you more control over how you present your message to your customer while still maintaining a professional look.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Desktop App
Mobile App
Confidently craft text in your desired tone with the AI-powered Rewrite button
Shared by Paige • April 15, 2024

The new Rewrite button uses AI to instantly rewrite any client-facing text to be shorter or more cheerful, professional, or casual. Now you don’t need to spend precious time crafting the perfect message; just one click and it's ready to send.

This functionality helps make client communication simple and is available anywhere you input client-facing text on getjobber.com and the mobile app.

Desktop App

We've also updated the quotes list to make it easier to navigate. Your detail columns now take up the entire page width for better visibility. With more sorting options and improved filtering, you can find what you need even faster.

Shared by Anna • April 03, 2024

With Reviews, your preferred customers will receive a review request after their invoice has been paid. Now, they will also get a follow-up the next day if they do not click the review link from the initial message they received. This automatic review follow-up will remind them to take action and lead to more customers leaving a review for your business.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Collect more information from your client with image uploads on your request form
Shared by Anna • March 18, 2024

Clients can now submit up to 4 images with their work request. With this extra information, you can better assess the scope of the work to ensure the right expectations are set with the client.

Image uploads are optional by default for all accounts but can be set to mandatory if you require images. If the client has submitted images with their work request, the images will appear as a note on the request.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with requests

Requests is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

## Easily schedule your email campaigns to send later

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** April 17, 2024

Easily schedule your email campaigns to send later

With Campaigns, you can draft your email when it's convenient for you and schedule it to send at an optimal day and time for your customers. Once a campaign is scheduled, you will see a 'Scheduled' status in your dashboard. You can hover over the campaign to 'Pause and edit' the campaign or 'Send now' if you want to override the scheduled date and time.

Customize your email content more effectively

When creating your email content, you can now apply different heading styles. This will give you more control over how you present your message to your customer while still maintaining a professional look.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Mobile App

Search is now more accessible and efficient
Workflow colors are back for easier differentiation
Statuses are brighter and bolder
Contrast on the side navigation has been improved for better visibility

The new design is the first of many enhancements focused on helping improve your experience with Jobber. Please keep sharing your feedback with us!

Learn more
Feature Update
Desktop App
Get insight into your client base with new client metrics
Shared by Paige • April 03, 2024

To provide you with more insight into your client base, we've added new metrics on the Clients page.

All Jobber accounts will show the number of clients added year-to-date and new clients added in the last 30 days. Plus, a trend indicator shows how this compares to the previous 30-day period. For Grow accounts with lead management access, you'll also see the number of new leads added in the last 30 days, along with a trend indicator.

These key metrics provide valuable insights, helping you stay on top of your business's health.

Learn more
Feature Update
Desktop App
Get more Google reviews with automatic follow-ups on Reviews
Shared by Anna • April 03, 2024

With Reviews, your preferred customers will receive a review request after their invoice has been paid. Now, they will also get a follow-up the next day if they do not click the review link from the initial message they received. This automatic review follow-up will remind them to take action and lead to more customers leaving a review for your business.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Reviews, visit our Help Center.

Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Mobile App
Feature Update
A new home view and a refreshed look for the mobile app
Shared by Cam • March 21, 2024

The new home view helps you stay focused on the important work at hand so you can navigate through your day more smoothly. At a glance, see your upcoming appointments on the map, or handle pending tasks in your new to-do list. Plus, the app has been refreshed with sleek, contemporary visuals and a more streamlined design that makes it even easier to use.

Keep an eye out for more updates coming soon that will further simplify and improve your experience with the app!

Learn more
Feature Update
Desktop App
Custom fields now included in the new visits report
Shared by Paige • March 19, 2024

You can now include custom fields in the visits report to keep track of details specific to your business, such as budgeted labor hours or type of work. The added flexibility allows you tailor the report for extra insight into your business operations.

Learn more

Note: some functionalities found in the visits report (legacy) are currently unavailable in the new visits report. The visits report (legacy) will remain accessible while we integrate additional features into the new report.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Collect more information from your client with image uploads on your request form
Shared by Anna • March 18, 2024

Clients can now submit up to 4 images with their work request. With this extra information, you can better assess the scope of the work to ensure the right expectations are set with the client.

Image uploads are optional by default for all accounts but can be set to mandatory if you require images. If the client has submitted images with their work request, the images will appear as a note on the request.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with requests

Requests is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Introducing Jobber Marketing Tools
Shared by Anna • March 11, 2024

## Get insight into your client base with new client metrics

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/47447-get-insight-into-your-client-base-with-new-client-metrics

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** April 17, 2024

Easily schedule your email campaigns to send later

With Campaigns, you can draft your email when it's convenient for you and schedule it to send at an optimal day and time for your customers. Once a campaign is scheduled, you will see a 'Scheduled' status in your dashboard. You can hover over the campaign to 'Pause and edit' the campaign or 'Send now' if you want to override the scheduled date and time.

Customize your email content more effectively

When creating your email content, you can now apply different heading styles. This will give you more control over how you present your message to your customer while still maintaining a professional look.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Desktop App
Mobile App
Confidently craft text in your desired tone with the AI-powered Rewrite button
Shared by Paige • April 15, 2024

This functionality helps make client communication simple and is available anywhere you input client-facing text on getjobber.com and the mobile app.

Desktop App

Desktop App
Mobile App

This functionality helps make client communication simple and is available anywhere you input client-facing text on getjobber.com and the mobile app.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Stay on top of your quotes with the new quotes page
Shared by Cam • April 12, 2024

It's now easier than ever to manage your quotes. New key metrics provide insight into how your quotes performed over the last 30 days. Trend percentages help you compare these numbers with the previous 30-day period. Plus, see the dollar value of sent vs. converted quotes so you know how much work you're winning.

We've also updated the quotes list to make it easier to navigate. Your detail columns now take up the entire page width for better visibility. With more sorting options and improved filtering, you can find what you need even faster.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Welcome to the new Jobber!
Shared by Cam • April 11, 2024

Our new design is now officially here to stay! We know this was a big change, and we thank you for your feedback over the last few weeks. We’ve made the following adjustments:

Search is now more accessible and efficient
Workflow colors are back for easier differentiation
Statuses are brighter and bolder
Contrast on the side navigation has been improved for better visibility

The new design is the first of many enhancements focused on helping improve your experience with Jobber. Please keep sharing your feedback with us!

Feature Update
Desktop App
Get insight into your client base with new client metrics
Shared by Paige • April 03, 2024

To provide you with more insight into your client base, we've added new metrics on the Clients page.

All Jobber accounts will show the number of clients added year-to-date and new clients added in the last 30 days. Plus, a trend indicator shows how this compares to the previous 30-day period. For Grow accounts with lead management access, you'll also see the number of new leads added in the last 30 days, along with a trend indicator.

These key metrics provide valuable insights, helping you stay on top of your business's health.

Learn more
Feature Update
Desktop App
Get more Google reviews with automatic follow-ups on Reviews
Shared by Anna • April 03, 2024

With Reviews, your preferred customers will receive a review request after their invoice has been paid. Now, they will also get a follow-up the next day if they do not click the review link from the initial message they received. This automatic review follow-up will remind them to take action and lead to more customers leaving a review for your business.

Get started with Reviews

Desktop App
Custom fields now included in the new visits report
Shared by Paige • March 19, 2024

Feature Update
Desktop App
Collect more information from your client with image uploads on your request form
Shared by Anna • March 18, 2024

Clients can now submit up to 4 images with their work request. With this extra information, you can better assess the scope of the work to ensure the right expectations are set with the client.

Image uploads are optional by default for all accounts but can be set to mandatory if you require images. If the client has submitted images with their work request, the images will appear as a note on the request.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Introducing Jobber Marketing Tools
Shared by Anna • March 11, 2024

Jobber Marketing Tools make it easy to whip up powerful email campaigns and put Google reviews to work for your business. Run your marketing from the same place you run your operations with built-in tools that are designed to work seamlessly in Jobber.

Keep your customers coming back with Campaigns. Whip up email campaigns in no time with editable templates that include your logo. There’s no limit to the number of campaigns you can make, or the amount of clients you can email. Plus, you can target specific clients to make sure you say the right thing to the right people.

Get started with Campaigns

Get more reviews with Reviews. Build up your online reputation and improve your visibility on Google with positive reviews from your customers. Automate review requests to your preferred customers after their invoice is paid, so you can focus on your work.

Get started with Reviews

To learn more about Marketing Tools, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available an an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans. Reviews is available as an add-on to all plans in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

## Introducing Jobber Marketing Tools

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/45486-introducing-jobber-marketing-tools

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** April 17, 2024

Easily schedule your email campaigns to send later

With Campaigns, you can draft your email when it's convenient for you and schedule it to send at an optimal day and time for your customers. Once a campaign is scheduled, you will see a 'Scheduled' status in your dashboard. You can hover over the campaign to 'Pause and edit' the campaign or 'Send now' if you want to override the scheduled date and time.

Customize your email content more effectively

When creating your email content, you can now apply different heading styles. This will give you more control over how you present your message to your customer while still maintaining a professional look.

Get started with Campaigns

To learn more about Campaigns, visit our Help Center.

Campaigns is available as an add-on to Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

## Track inbound phone calls and lead sources with CallRail

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/45324-track-inbound-phone-calls-and-lead-sources-with-callrail

**Shared by:** Paige

**Date:** March 08, 2024

CallRail is a call tracking and analytics software that helps you to understand which marketing efforts bring in the most leads and convert to paying jobs.

With the new CallRail integration, each inbound phone call you receive will create a new lead or sync to an existing client in Jobber. You’ll see their contact information, lead source, and a timestamped record of every phone call automatically in the client’s profile.

Get started

Available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Save time booking assessments with online booking
Shared by Anna • February 15, 2024

You can now offer assessments as a bookable service for your customers. When setting up your bookable services for your online booking page, you will specify if the service should be booked as an assessment or a job. This will help cut the back and forth between you and your customer and ensure your reporting is accurate for assessments and jobs.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
Mobile App
New Feature
New improvements to organize and create notes more quickly
Shared by Cam • February 01, 2024

With just a click, you can now pin client notes to always appear first, even as new notes are added. Pinned notes will appear on top of the notes section on all devices to help your team keep track of the most important details, especially if there are multiple notes attached to a client or work item.

Plus, your browser and app now remember which work items your most recent note was linked to, so you can save even more time when creating new notes even when on the go.

Learn more
Mobile App
Feature Update
Get directions or let clients know you're on the way in just one tap
Shared by Paige • January 31, 2024

It's now easier than ever to find directions to your next job or text your client that you're on the way while working in the field!

While viewing a visit in the Jobber mobile app, you will see two buttons under the name and address of your client. Tap Directions to open your preferred maps app and drive confidently to your next job. Tap On my way to text your client an estimated arrival time.

Learn more

On my way texts is available on the Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Be better prepared for the job with image uploads in online booking
Shared by Anna • January 17, 2024

Clients can now submit up to 4 images with their online booking. Images give you an opportunity to quickly assess the scope of the work before you get onsite so you can set the right expectations with the client.

If the client has submitted images with their booking, the images will appear as a note on the visit.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

P.S. stay tuned for this to make its way to another highly requested area in Jobber soon!

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
New Feature
See all completed job forms at a glance in the new job forms report
Shared by Paige • January 15, 2024

The job forms report makes it easy to access and recall information collected from job forms in bulk.

Customize your report by selecting the name of the form and a date range to see how each field in the job form was completed. This will allow you to compare jobs and reference key information from your job forms quickly and easily.

To learn more about the job forms report, visit our Help Center.

View my report

Job forms is available on the Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Quickly tag multiple clients with bulk tagging in the updated clients list
Shared by Anna • December 13, 2023

Bulk tagging is here! The Clients list has been improved to make managing clients faster and navigating the list easier. With bulk tagging, you can now select multiple clients from the list and edit their tags by adding new tags or removing existing tags.

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Quickly tag, email, or archive a client with hover actions in the updated clients list
Shared by Anna • December 07, 2023

The clients list has been improved to make managing clients faster and navigating the list easier. With hover actions, you can quickly tag, email, archive, or delete a single client by simply hovering over the client with your mouse.

Stay tuned for bulk actions! To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Gain confidence in your recurring job profitability with job costing
Shared by Cam • December 06, 2023

Job costing is now available for recurring jobs! On the recurring jobs page, you will now see a profit bar showing your profitability over the past 30 days. This profit bar displays a calculation of your 30-day average profit margin, revenue, line item costs, labor, expenses, and profit.

Getting a snapshot of your profitability helps you ensure you’re turning a profit with your repeat customers, and helps you improve pricing and costing accuracy for new recurring business.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Mobile App
Keep your clients informed with assessment booking confirmations
Shared by Anna • November 30, 2023

Keep your clients informed every step of the way by sending booking confirmations for scheduled assessments from jobber.com or the mobile app. This way, your client always has the right expectations of their upcoming appointment.

To learn more about booking confirmations, please visit our Help Center.

Booking confirmations are available on Connect and Grow plans.

Customize your report by selecting the name of the form and a date range to see how each field in the job form was completed. This will allow you to compare jobs and reference key information from your job forms quickly and easily.

To learn more about the job forms report, visit our Help Center.

View my report

Job forms is available on the Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App

Feature Update
Desktop App
Quickly tag, email, or archive a client with hover actions in the updated clients list

Feature Update
Desktop App
Gain confidence in your recurring job profitability with job costing

Getting a snapshot of your profitability helps you ensure you’re turning a profit with your repeat customers, and helps you improve pricing and costing accuracy for new recurring business.

Get started with online booking

Desktop App
Mobile App
New Feature
New improvements to organize and create notes more quickly
Shared by Cam • February 01, 2024

With just a click, you can now pin client notes to always appear first, even as new notes are added. Pinned notes will appear on top of the notes section on all devices to help your team keep track of the most important details, especially if there are multiple notes attached to a client or work item.

Plus, your browser and app now remember which work items your most recent note was linked to, so you can save even more time when creating new notes even when on the go.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Get directions or let clients know you're on the way in just one tap

P.S. stay tuned for this to make its way to another highly requested area in Jobber soon!

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
New Feature
See all completed job forms at a glance in the new job forms report
Shared by Paige • January 15, 2024

The job forms report makes it easy to access and recall information collected from job forms in bulk.

Customize your report by selecting the name of the form and a date range to see how each field in the job form was completed. This will allow you to compare jobs and reference key information from your job forms quickly and easily.

To learn more about the job forms report, visit our Help Center.

View my report

Job forms is available on the Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Quickly tag multiple clients with bulk tagging in the updated clients list
Shared by Anna • December 13, 2023

Bulk tagging is here! The Clients list has been improved to make managing clients faster and navigating the list easier. With bulk tagging, you can now select multiple clients from the list and edit their tags by adding new tags or removing existing tags.

To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Quickly tag, email, or archive a client with hover actions in the updated clients list
Shared by Anna • December 07, 2023

The clients list has been improved to make managing clients faster and navigating the list easier. With hover actions, you can quickly tag, email, archive, or delete a single client by simply hovering over the client with your mouse.

Stay tuned for bulk actions! To learn more about client management, visit our Help Center.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Gain confidence in your recurring job profitability with job costing
Shared by Cam • December 06, 2023

Job costing is now available for recurring jobs! On the recurring jobs page, you will now see a profit bar showing your profitability over the past 30 days. This profit bar displays a calculation of your 30-day average profit margin, revenue, line item costs, labor, expenses, and profit.

Getting a snapshot of your profitability helps you ensure you’re turning a profit with your repeat customers, and helps you improve pricing and costing accuracy for new recurring business.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Mobile App
Keep your clients informed with assessment booking confirmations
Shared by Anna • November 30, 2023

Keep your clients informed every step of the way by sending booking confirmations for scheduled assessments from jobber.com or the mobile app. This way, your client always has the right expectations of their upcoming appointment.

To learn more about booking confirmations, please visit our Help Center.

Booking confirmations are available on Connect and Grow plans.

## Incentivize your workers and manage leads with these new integrations

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/34740-incentivize-your-workers-and-manage-leads-with-these-new-integrations

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** November 15, 2023

Incentivize your workers with Protiv

Protiv is a worker incentive program that allows contractors to connect their company goals to worker output. Using the integration with Jobber we connect all jobs, attendance, and users to create an automated incentive program. Learn more

Available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans in the United States and Canada.

Manage leads and increase conversion with Toolsey

Toolsey is a powerful lead management system designed to reduce response times and increase conversion. All leads are synced to Jobber, along with any documentation, so there is no need for manual entry. Learn more

Available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans in the United States.

Discover apps and web services to help you do more with Jobber.

View App Marketplace
Feature Update
Desktop App
Find what you need faster with the improved Products & Services list
Shared by Cam • October 30, 2023

A new search bar, sorting options, and more—we’ve made Products & Services easier to navigate so you can find what you need faster. All your items are now listed together, with a "Type" column to indicate whether they are products or services. Using the new search bar, you can instantly find items with matching names or descriptions.

By default, the new list is sorted alphabetically. You can temporarily sort items by name or type to speed up your search. Plus, you can now view your items by pages instead of scrolling through an endlessly long list, saving you even more time.

To learn more about Products & Services, please visit our Help Center.

See your Products & Services
New Feature
Mobile App
Maintain accurate and up-to-date timesheets with location timers
Shared by Cam • October 24, 2023

Never miss a time entry again. Set location timers to automatically start and stop when your team arrives at and leaves a client’s property. Or, get Jobber to send your team push notifications that remind them to clock in and out manually—whatever works best for your operations.

Using location timers helps you reduce the time spent fixing errors and incomplete timesheets so you can get payroll done faster. Plus, when you use location timers with job costing, you get a clear picture of labor costs associated with each job to improve costing accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Location timers and job costing are available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Spend less time scheduling and driving with online booking
Shared by Anna • October 18, 2023

With our new drive time feature, bookings made online will ensure you have a more efficient schedule and, as a result, burn less fuel/gas. This feature works best when used with the service area feature to ensure that all bookings you receive are within your service area and in close proximity to other scheduled jobs.

Once you’ve enabled the drive time feature, your customers will be offered time slots that are a close drive away from other scheduled jobs by leveraging your maximum drive time. The feature will also use historical traffic patterns to ensure you have enough time to get to your next job site.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. Drive time feature is available in most countries including the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia.

Desktop App
New Feature
See revenue and cost trends with job insights
Shared by Cam • October 17, 2023

Job insights give you a visual representation of your most important revenue metrics that help you easily understand how your one-off jobs are performing, identify opportunities to boost profitability, and uncover any potential issues early on.

One-off job projections: See how much revenue to expect and how many jobs are scheduled in the next 30 days so you can plan ahead and make adjustments if needed.

One-off job trends: See a historical 6-month view of your revenue and number of scheduled jobs. If you have job costing, you will see a revenue vs. cost comparison over time and a monthly breakdown of your costs and profit.

To learn more about job insights, visit our Help Center.

See your job insights

Job insights is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.
Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Desktop App
New Feature
Easily track requests and assessments with the new report
Shared by Cam • October 03, 2023

Make better business decisions with the new requests report (beta). You can now view your requests and assessments data over time by selecting a specific date range. Further customize your report by selecting only the columns of data that you need like request title, status, assessment date, and more.

Keeping track of how many of your requests have led to assessments, quotes, and jobs will help you improve your pipeline. The report will link to any quotes or jobs generated from the request and also includes your customer’s responses to your online request form questions.

To learn more about the new requests report, visit our Help Center.

View your requests report

Requests are available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Mobile App
Jobber app now available in Spanish for non-admins
Shared by Anna • September 27, 2023

Jobber is now available in Spanish for all non-admins in the Jobber mobile app. This means Spanish-speaking team members can more easily manage their work in Jobber, including viewing their schedule, sending “on my way” texts, using timers, invoicing, and collecting payment.

Jobber will automatically appear in Spanish when:

User is a non-admin in Jobber
User has their mobile device language preference set to Spanish
User has updated to the latest version of the Jobber mobile app

To learn more, visit our Help Center.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Desktop App
More control over your appointment time slots for online booking
Shared by Anna • September 27, 2023

You can now set the interval your appointment times will be offered at. You can have appointments as often as every 30 minutes or as little as every 4 hours. These intervals will begin at the start of your business hours. This setting will allow you to better optimize your schedule by having more control over the number of appointments you make available, and when, on any given day.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Improved collection of client information for online booking
Shared by Anna • September 26, 2023

When a client fills out their information while making a booking, they will now have space to leave a note with additional details. This is where the client can provide more details about the job to be done, how to gain access to their property, or any other details. The details provided will appear in the visit instructions.

Additionally, your client's phone number and email address are required in order to proceed with the booking. This way, you can ensure you are collecting all the contact information you need in order to do business with them.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Speed up and simplify payroll with Gusto
Shared by Mark • September 19, 2023

Gusto is an all-in-one HR platform that puts the tools you need to hire, pay, and manage your team at your fingertips.

Our new Gusto integration lets you automatically sync timesheets and reimbursable expenses from Jobber to Gusto, saving you time while ensuring accurate, on-time, and compliant payroll.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

The Gusto integration is available to Jobber customers in the U.S. and on our Connect and Grow plans.

Protiv is a worker incentive program that allows contractors to connect their company goals to worker output. Using the integration with Jobber we connect all jobs, attendance, and users to create an automated incentive program. Learn more

Available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans in the United States and Canada.

Manage leads and increase conversion with Toolsey

Toolsey is a powerful lead management system designed to reduce response times and increase conversion. All leads are synced to Jobber, along with any documentation, so there is no need for manual entry. Learn more

Available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans in the United States.

Discover apps and web services to help you do more with Jobber.

View App Marketplace
Feature Update
Desktop App
Find what you need faster with the improved Products & Services list
Shared by Cam • October 30, 2023

A new search bar, sorting options, and more—we’ve made Products & Services easier to navigate so you can find what you need faster. All your items are now listed together, with a "Type" column to indicate whether they are products or services. Using the new search bar, you can instantly find items with matching names or descriptions.

By default, the new list is sorted alphabetically. You can temporarily sort items by name or type to speed up your search. Plus, you can now view your items by pages instead of scrolling through an endlessly long list, saving you even more time.

To learn more about Products & Services, please visit our Help Center.

See your Products & Services
New Feature
Mobile App
Maintain accurate and up-to-date timesheets with location timers
Shared by Cam • October 24, 2023

Never miss a time entry again. Set location timers to automatically start and stop when your team arrives at and leaves a client’s property. Or, get Jobber to send your team push notifications that remind them to clock in and out manually—whatever works best for your operations.

Using location timers helps you reduce the time spent fixing errors and incomplete timesheets so you can get payroll done faster. Plus, when you use location timers with job costing, you get a clear picture of labor costs associated with each job to improve costing accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Location timers and job costing are available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Spend less time scheduling and driving with online booking
Shared by Anna • October 18, 2023

With our new drive time feature, bookings made online will ensure you have a more efficient schedule and, as a result, burn less fuel/gas. This feature works best when used with the service area feature to ensure that all bookings you receive are within your service area and in close proximity to other scheduled jobs.

Once you’ve enabled the drive time feature, your customers will be offered time slots that are a close drive away from other scheduled jobs by leveraging your maximum drive time. The feature will also use historical traffic patterns to ensure you have enough time to get to your next job site.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. Drive time feature is available in most countries including the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia.

Desktop App
New Feature
See revenue and cost trends with job insights
Shared by Cam • October 17, 2023

Job insights give you a visual representation of your most important revenue metrics that help you easily understand how your one-off jobs are performing, identify opportunities to boost profitability, and uncover any potential issues early on.

One-off job projections: See how much revenue to expect and how many jobs are scheduled in the next 30 days so you can plan ahead and make adjustments if needed.

One-off job trends: See a historical 6-month view of your revenue and number of scheduled jobs. If you have job costing, you will see a revenue vs. cost comparison over time and a monthly breakdown of your costs and profit.

To learn more about job insights, visit our Help Center.

See your job insights

Job insights is available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.
Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Desktop App
New Feature
Easily track requests and assessments with the new report
Shared by Cam • October 03, 2023

Make better business decisions with the new requests report (beta). You can now view your requests and assessments data over time by selecting a specific date range. Further customize your report by selecting only the columns of data that you need like request title, status, assessment date, and more.

Keeping track of how many of your requests have led to assessments, quotes, and jobs will help you improve your pipeline. The report will link to any quotes or jobs generated from the request and also includes your customer’s responses to your online request form questions.

To learn more about the new requests report, visit our Help Center.

View your requests report

Requests are available on Core, Connect, and Grow plans.

Mobile App
Jobber app now available in Spanish for non-admins
Shared by Anna • September 27, 2023

Jobber is now available in Spanish for all non-admins in the Jobber mobile app. This means Spanish-speaking team members can more easily manage their work in Jobber, including viewing their schedule, sending “on my way” texts, using timers, invoicing, and collecting payment.

Jobber will automatically appear in Spanish when:

User is a non-admin in Jobber
User has their mobile device language preference set to Spanish
User has updated to the latest version of the Jobber mobile app

To learn more, visit our Help Center.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Desktop App
More control over your appointment time slots for online booking
Shared by Anna • September 27, 2023

You can now set the interval your appointment times will be offered at. You can have appointments as often as every 30 minutes or as little as every 4 hours. These intervals will begin at the start of your business hours. This setting will allow you to better optimize your schedule by having more control over the number of appointments you make available, and when, on any given day.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Improved collection of client information for online booking
Shared by Anna • September 26, 2023

When a client fills out their information while making a booking, they will now have space to leave a note with additional details. This is where the client can provide more details about the job to be done, how to gain access to their property, or any other details. The details provided will appear in the visit instructions.

Additionally, your client's phone number and email address are required in order to proceed with the booking. This way, you can ensure you are collecting all the contact information you need in order to do business with them.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Speed up and simplify payroll with Gusto
Shared by Mark • September 19, 2023

Gusto is an all-in-one HR platform that puts the tools you need to hire, pay, and manage your team at your fingertips.

Our new Gusto integration lets you automatically sync timesheets and reimbursable expenses from Jobber to Gusto, saving you time while ensuring accurate, on-time, and compliant payroll.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

The Gusto integration is available to Jobber customers in the U.S. and on our Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
See revenue and cost trends with job insights
