## Turn on automatic payments and request a card on file when creating recurring jobs

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/29162-turn-on-automatic-payments-and-request-a-card-on-file-when-creating-recurring-jobs

**Shared by:** Mark

**Date:** September 07, 2023

Automatic payments help you get paid faster while saving you and your customers time. That’s why we’ve made it even easier to turn on automatic payments for recurring jobs. Now, you can ask your customers for a card on file and pre-enable automatic payments at the same time. Once your customer saves their card in client hub it will be charged automatically after an invoice is created.

To learn more about card on file automatic payments, visit our Help Center.

Automatic Payments are available on Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Send and collect signed agreements faster with Jobber and DocuSign
Shared by Anna • September 06, 2023

DocuSign makes signature collection easier for you and your clients.

The new DocuSign integration makes creating agreements and managing their progress within Jobber a breeze–saving you time and giving you increased visibility into approvals. You can automatically draft up a DocuSign agreement for the client when a quote is sent or approved, or when a job is created in Jobber. Plus, the agreement template you set up in DocuSign can automatically populate Jobber fields–such as client name, property address, quote number, and more–onto your DocuSign agreement. Once sent, you can keep an eye on the signature status from Jobber within the quote or job created for the client.

Get started

The DocuSign integration is available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States and Canada.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Set a service area to limit who can book your services online
Shared by Anna • August 09, 2023

You can now set a service area for online booking which limits who can book online based on their address. When enabled, the first step of your online booking page will now ask for your customer’s zip/postal code. If they aren’t within your service area, the booking page will ask that they instead contact you directly for more information. This will help you control how far you’ll travel for an appointment with more controls coming soon!

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Virtually measure properties and automatically import data into Jobber with Deep Lawn
Shared by Anna • July 27, 2023

Deep Lawn helps lawn care, landscaping and pest control businesses virtually measure properties right from their website.

The new Deep Lawn integration gives you easy access to the square footage of client’s properties by importing that data into your client’s profile. You’ll also be able to access the square footage when you create a quote for the client to help make quoting within Jobber more efficient.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Integrations
Never miss a customer with SnapPicFix
Shared by Anna • July 25, 2023

SnapPicFix is a digital answering service that helps you engage with your customers within seconds; delivering the 5-star customer service they expect without lifting a finger.

The new SnapPicFix integration will sync new clients and work requests into Jobber so you don’t have to worry about manual entries and have all the information you need within Jobber.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Integrations
Take control of your online reputation with Grab Your Reviews
Shared by Anna • July 25, 2023

Grab Your Reviews is a review management platform that helps maximize your business’s full growth potential. Monitor, generate and share reviews that help your brand create noise in the market.

The new Grab Your Reviews integration helps you with the collection of reviews by automatically sending a ‘Get Reviews’ campaign when you close a job or send an invoice–you can set which trigger to use.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Mobile App
Feature Update
Easily switch between schedule views in the mobile app
Shared by Cam • July 18, 2023

With Jobber, you can view your schedule in several ways. Now, there’s an easier way to switch between these schedule views when you're on the move.

In the Schedule tab in the mobile app, you can now change to the Day, List, or Map view with just a tap. These frequently used options are now displayed at the top of the screen, so it's faster to switch to the view you want.

The Week and 3-Day view, along with more options for your schedule, can still be accessed by tapping on the View Options icon on the top right corner of the screen.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Desktop App
Allow customers to select quantities on your bookable services for online booking
Shared by Anna • July 11, 2023

You can now configure your bookable services to allow your customers to select a quantity and set limits on the minimum and maximum quantities you will accept. The duration and price you set for these services will apply to a single quantity; this will ensure more accurate price estimations and appointment durations during the booking process. There are also more service duration options available with this update.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Mobile App
Feature Update
View and manage unscheduled work on the go
Shared by Cam • July 07, 2023

It's now easier than ever to take care of unscheduled work while on the go. In the Jobber mobile app, you can now view and manage your unscheduled visits, assessments, and tasks on the map.

Unscheduled appointments can be easily identified by their unique icon. To schedule them, simply tap on the icon to open the visit details.

Team members with scheduling permissions can assign or reassign work to other team members who are closer to the client’s property.

Schedule nearby appointments together so your team can get more done while minimizing their drive time. By knowing where your unscheduled appointments are, you and your team can pick up nearby work more quickly.

## Send and collect signed agreements faster with Jobber and DocuSign

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/28823-send-and-collect-signed-agreements-faster-with-jobber-and-docusign

**Shared by:** Mark

**Date:** September 07, 2023

Automatic payments help you get paid faster while saving you and your customers time. That’s why we’ve made it even easier to turn on automatic payments for recurring jobs. Now, you can ask your customers for a card on file and pre-enable automatic payments at the same time. Once your customer saves their card in client hub it will be charged automatically after an invoice is created.

To learn more about card on file automatic payments, visit our Help Center.

Automatic Payments are available on Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Send and collect signed agreements faster with Jobber and DocuSign
Shared by Anna • September 06, 2023

DocuSign makes signature collection easier for you and your clients.

The new DocuSign integration makes creating agreements and managing their progress within Jobber a breeze–saving you time and giving you increased visibility into approvals. You can automatically draft up a DocuSign agreement for the client when a quote is sent or approved, or when a job is created in Jobber. Plus, the agreement template you set up in DocuSign can automatically populate Jobber fields–such as client name, property address, quote number, and more–onto your DocuSign agreement. Once sent, you can keep an eye on the signature status from Jobber within the quote or job created for the client.

Get started

The DocuSign integration is available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States and Canada.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Set a service area to limit who can book your services online
Shared by Anna • August 09, 2023

You can now set a service area for online booking which limits who can book online based on their address. When enabled, the first step of your online booking page will now ask for your customer’s zip/postal code. If they aren’t within your service area, the booking page will ask that they instead contact you directly for more information. This will help you control how far you’ll travel for an appointment with more controls coming soon!

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Virtually measure properties and automatically import data into Jobber with Deep Lawn
Shared by Anna • July 27, 2023

Deep Lawn helps lawn care, landscaping and pest control businesses virtually measure properties right from their website.

The new Deep Lawn integration gives you easy access to the square footage of client’s properties by importing that data into your client’s profile. You’ll also be able to access the square footage when you create a quote for the client to help make quoting within Jobber more efficient.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Integrations
Never miss a customer with SnapPicFix
Shared by Anna • July 25, 2023

SnapPicFix is a digital answering service that helps you engage with your customers within seconds; delivering the 5-star customer service they expect without lifting a finger.

The new SnapPicFix integration will sync new clients and work requests into Jobber so you don’t have to worry about manual entries and have all the information you need within Jobber.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Integrations
Take control of your online reputation with Grab Your Reviews
Shared by Anna • July 25, 2023

Grab Your Reviews is a review management platform that helps maximize your business’s full growth potential. Monitor, generate and share reviews that help your brand create noise in the market.

The new Grab Your Reviews integration helps you with the collection of reviews by automatically sending a ‘Get Reviews’ campaign when you close a job or send an invoice–you can set which trigger to use.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Mobile App
Feature Update
Easily switch between schedule views in the mobile app
Shared by Cam • July 18, 2023

With Jobber, you can view your schedule in several ways. Now, there’s an easier way to switch between these schedule views when you're on the move.

In the Schedule tab in the mobile app, you can now change to the Day, List, or Map view with just a tap. These frequently used options are now displayed at the top of the screen, so it's faster to switch to the view you want.

The Week and 3-Day view, along with more options for your schedule, can still be accessed by tapping on the View Options icon on the top right corner of the screen.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Desktop App
Allow customers to select quantities on your bookable services for online booking
Shared by Anna • July 11, 2023

You can now configure your bookable services to allow your customers to select a quantity and set limits on the minimum and maximum quantities you will accept. The duration and price you set for these services will apply to a single quantity; this will ensure more accurate price estimations and appointment durations during the booking process. There are also more service duration options available with this update.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Mobile App
Feature Update
View and manage unscheduled work on the go
Shared by Cam • July 07, 2023

It's now easier than ever to take care of unscheduled work while on the go. In the Jobber mobile app, you can now view and manage your unscheduled visits, assessments, and tasks on the map.

Unscheduled appointments can be easily identified by their unique icon. To schedule them, simply tap on the icon to open the visit details.

Team members with scheduling permissions can assign or reassign work to other team members who are closer to the client’s property.

Schedule nearby appointments together so your team can get more done while minimizing their drive time. By knowing where your unscheduled appointments are, you and your team can pick up nearby work more quickly.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Shared by Anna • July 25, 2023

Grab Your Reviews is a review management platform that helps maximize your business’s full growth potential. Monitor, generate and share reviews that help your brand create noise in the market.

The new Grab Your Reviews integration helps you with the collection of reviews by automatically sending a ‘Get Reviews’ campaign when you close a job or send an invoice–you can set which trigger to use.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Mobile App
Feature Update
Easily switch between schedule views in the mobile app
Shared by Cam • July 18, 2023

With Jobber, you can view your schedule in several ways. Now, there’s an easier way to switch between these schedule views when you're on the move.

In the Schedule tab in the mobile app, you can now change to the Day, List, or Map view with just a tap. These frequently used options are now displayed at the top of the screen, so it's faster to switch to the view you want.

The Week and 3-Day view, along with more options for your schedule, can still be accessed by tapping on the View Options icon on the top right corner of the screen.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Desktop App
Allow customers to select quantities on your bookable services for online booking
Shared by Anna • July 11, 2023

You can now configure your bookable services to allow your customers to select a quantity and set limits on the minimum and maximum quantities you will accept. The duration and price you set for these services will apply to a single quantity; this will ensure more accurate price estimations and appointment durations during the booking process. There are also more service duration options available with this update.

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Mobile App
Feature Update
View and manage unscheduled work on the go
Shared by Cam • July 07, 2023

It's now easier than ever to take care of unscheduled work while on the go. In the Jobber mobile app, you can now view and manage your unscheduled visits, assessments, and tasks on the map.

Unscheduled appointments can be easily identified by their unique icon. To schedule them, simply tap on the icon to open the visit details.

Team members with scheduling permissions can assign or reassign work to other team members who are closer to the client’s property.

Schedule nearby appointments together so your team can get more done while minimizing their drive time. By knowing where your unscheduled appointments are, you and your team can pick up nearby work more quickly.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Desktop App
Feature Update
View online booking and job costing data in the one-off jobs report
Shared by Cam • June 22, 2023

Along with the launch of online booking and job costing, we’ve also updated the one-off jobs report (beta) to provide you with even more insights into your job performance.

Online booking

A new column has been added to show if the job was booked online so you can quickly compare details and see how your booked jobs are performing.

Job costing

Analyzing your job profitability for a range of jobs has been made even easier. At the bottom of the report, you can now see:

average profitability
total profit
total labor hours
total labor costs
total line item costs
total expense costs
total costs

With this new information on the report, you can spend less time on calculations and spreadsheets and more time making decisions that increase your efficiency and profitability.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

## Easily switch between schedule views in the mobile app

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/25306-easily-switch-between-schedule-views-in-the-mobile-app

**Shared by:** Mark

**Date:** September 07, 2023

Automatic payments help you get paid faster while saving you and your customers time. That’s why we’ve made it even easier to turn on automatic payments for recurring jobs. Now, you can ask your customers for a card on file and pre-enable automatic payments at the same time. Once your customer saves their card in client hub it will be charged automatically after an invoice is created.

To learn more about card on file automatic payments, visit our Help Center.

Automatic Payments are available on Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Send and collect signed agreements faster with Jobber and DocuSign
Shared by Anna • September 06, 2023

DocuSign makes signature collection easier for you and your clients.

The new DocuSign integration makes creating agreements and managing their progress within Jobber a breeze–saving you time and giving you increased visibility into approvals. You can automatically draft up a DocuSign agreement for the client when a quote is sent or approved, or when a job is created in Jobber. Plus, the agreement template you set up in DocuSign can automatically populate Jobber fields–such as client name, property address, quote number, and more–onto your DocuSign agreement. Once sent, you can keep an eye on the signature status from Jobber within the quote or job created for the client.

Get started

The DocuSign integration is available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States and Canada.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Set a service area to limit who can book your services online
Shared by Anna • August 09, 2023

You can now set a service area for online booking which limits who can book online based on their address. When enabled, the first step of your online booking page will now ask for your customer’s zip/postal code. If they aren’t within your service area, the booking page will ask that they instead contact you directly for more information. This will help you control how far you’ll travel for an appointment with more controls coming soon!

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Integrations
Virtually measure properties and automatically import data into Jobber with Deep Lawn
Shared by Anna • July 27, 2023

Deep Lawn helps lawn care, landscaping and pest control businesses virtually measure properties right from their website.

The new Deep Lawn integration gives you easy access to the square footage of client’s properties by importing that data into your client’s profile. You’ll also be able to access the square footage when you create a quote for the client to help make quoting within Jobber more efficient.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Get started
Integrations

The new SnapPicFix integration will sync new clients and work requests into Jobber so you don’t have to worry about manual entries and have all the information you need within Jobber.

You can automatically draft up a DocuSign agreement for the client when a quote is sent or approved, or when a job is created in Jobber. Plus, the agreement template you set up in DocuSign can automatically populate Jobber fields–such as client name, property address, quote number, and more–onto your DocuSign agreement. Once sent, you can keep an eye on the signature status from Jobber within the quote or job created for the client.

Get started

The DocuSign integration is available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States and Canada.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Set a service area to limit who can book your services online
Shared by Anna • August 09, 2023

You can now set a service area for online booking which limits who can book online based on their address. When enabled, the first step of your online booking page will now ask for your customer’s zip/postal code. If they aren’t within your service area, the booking page will ask that they instead contact you directly for more information. This will help you control how far you’ll travel for an appointment with more controls coming soon!

To learn more about online booking, visit our Help Center.

Get started with online booking

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

Deep Lawn helps lawn care, landscaping and pest control businesses virtually measure properties right from their website.

The new Deep Lawn integration gives you easy access to the square footage of client’s properties by importing that data into your client’s profile. You’ll also be able to access the square footage when you create a quote for the client to help make quoting within Jobber more efficient.

To get started with the integration, or to learn more, please visit the App Marketplace listing.

Feature Update
Easily switch between schedule views in the mobile app
Shared by Cam • July 18, 2023

With Jobber, you can view your schedule in several ways. Now, there’s an easier way to switch between these schedule views when you're on the move.

View and manage unscheduled work on the go
Shared by Cam • July 07, 2023

average profitability

## Be confident that every job is profitable with job costing

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/22452-be-confident-that-every-job-is-profitable-with-job-costing

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more

Automate repetitive tasks by setting up triggers in one app to automatically complete actions in another app. With Zapier integration you can connect Jobber with 2000+ apps for automated workflows

To get setup, toggle referrals “on” in your client hub settings or visit our Help Center for more information.

Product Bulletin
Mobile App
Desktop App
Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Getting your team started with Jobber is now easier than ever
Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

We’ve updated the invitations that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running.

After adding them to your Jobber account, new non-admin users who join through their mobile device will receive an email or text with a link to download the Jobber mobile app. Once they download and open the app, all their details will be automatically filled in; all they have to do is set a password to complete the setup. No more switching back and forth between a browser and the app!

This simplified process allows your team to get up and running quickly so you can focus on other priorities.

Learn more

User limits vary per plan type.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

New Feature
Consistently meet client expectations with arrival windows
Shared by Cam • March 23, 2023

Home service professionals deal with unexpected situations every day. How do you stay on track when the smallest things can derail your day?

Communicating an arrival window instead of a fixed time makes it easier for you to stay on schedule and meet client expectations consistently.

Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Add a window after the start time or center the window on the start time, whichever works best for your operations. Set a default window for all your jobs, and customize each one as needed. Arrival windows give you greater flexibility to manage your time so you can continue to provide the best service to your clients.

Learn more

Arrival windows, booking confirmations, and visit reminders are available on Connect and Grow plans.

For your clients to receive arrival window information, booking confirmations and/or visit reminders need to be enabled.

You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update

## Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more
Desktop App
Integrations
Feature Update
Mobile App
New features available on the Connect plan to help you automate tasks and grow your business
Shared by Rafael • May 10, 2023
Let Jobber and Zapier handle your routine tasks

Automate repetitive tasks by setting up triggers in one app to automatically complete actions in another app. With Zapier integration you can connect Jobber with 2000+ apps for automated workflows

To get started find Zapier in our App Marketplace or visit our Help Center to learn more.

Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with referrals!

Customers can now refer your business from the client hub.

“Refer a friend” prompts in client hub encourage customers to share booking links with their friends and family or on social media, so you can generate quality leads. Referred leads will arrive in Jobber as new requests, tagged with the name of the customer that referred them.

To get setup, toggle referrals “on” in your client hub settings or visit our Help Center for more information.

Customers can submit their request through your website, social media, or in client hub at any time. You’ll receive a notification as soon as a new request comes in, to action it.

To get started, navigate to Requests to set up your form or visit our Help Center for more information.

Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with Referrals!

Customers can now refer your business from the client hub.

“Refer a friend” prompts in client hub encourage customers to share booking links with their friends and family or on social media, so you can generate quality leads. Referred leads will arrive in Jobber as new requests, tagged with the name of the customer that referred them.

To get setup, toggle referrals “on” in your client hub settings or visit our Help Center for more information.

Connect additional apps to help grow your business

Google Local services ad integration (US only) connects you to customers with less effort. When customers find you through Google, with the Jobber integration, customers will also see an option to schedule an available time in your Jobber calendar.

Thumbtack (US only) is a marketplace for finding local professionals. Integrate Jobber with Thumbtack to spend less time looking for work and let Thumbtack match you with the jobs you want.

To learn more about our apps and integrations visit our Help Center

Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

## Save time on scheduling with online booking

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/21016-save-time-on-scheduling-with-online-booking

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more

Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Getting your team started with Jobber is now easier than ever
Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

We’ve updated the invitations that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running.

After adding them to your Jobber account, new non-admin users who join through their mobile device will receive an email or text with a link to download the Jobber mobile app. Once they download and open the app, all their details will be automatically filled in; all they have to do is set a password to complete the setup. No more switching back and forth between a browser and the app!

This simplified process allows your team to get up and running quickly so you can focus on other priorities.

New Feature
Consistently meet client expectations with arrival windows
Shared by Cam • March 23, 2023

Home service professionals deal with unexpected situations every day. How do you stay on track when the smallest things can derail your day?

Communicating an arrival window instead of a fixed time makes it easier for you to stay on schedule and meet client expectations consistently.

Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Add a window after the start time or center the window on the start time, whichever works best for your operations. Set a default window for all your jobs, and customize each one as needed. Arrival windows give you greater flexibility to manage your time so you can continue to provide the best service to your clients.

With a personal number included in the message, customers can directly contact their assigned service pro for any concerns.

## New features available on the Connect plan to help you automate tasks and grow your business

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/19240-new-features-available-on-the-connect-plan-to-help-you-automate-tasks-and-grow-your-business

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more
Desktop App
Integrations
Feature Update
Mobile App
New features available on the Connect plan to help you automate tasks and grow your business
Shared by Rafael • May 10, 2023

Automate repetitive tasks by setting up triggers in one app to automatically complete actions in another app. With Zapier integration you can connect Jobber with 2000+ apps for automated workflows

To get started find Zapier in our App Marketplace or visit our Help Center to learn more.

Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with referrals!

Customers can now refer your business from the client hub.

“Refer a friend” prompts in client hub encourage customers to share booking links with their friends and family or on social media, so you can generate quality leads. Referred leads will arrive in Jobber as new requests, tagged with the name of the customer that referred them.

To get setup, toggle referrals “on” in your client hub settings or visit our Help Center for more information.

Mobile App

New features available on the Core plan to help you find more leads!
Shared by Rafael • May 10, 2023
Never miss a lead with Requests

You can now let leads and customers request work through your website or social media.

Customize your request form to capture all the information you need from the customer to begin with quoting or scheduling the job. Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with Referrals!

Google Local services ad integration (US only) connects you to customers with less effort. When customers find you through Google, with the Jobber integration, customers will also see an option to schedule an available time in your Jobber calendar.

Product Bulletin
Mobile App
Desktop App
Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Getting your team started with Jobber is now easier than ever
Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

We’ve updated the invitations that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running.

After adding them to your Jobber account, new non-admin users who join through their mobile device will receive an email or text with a link to download the Jobber mobile app. Once they download and open the app, all their details will be automatically filled in; all they have to do is set a password to complete the setup. No more switching back and forth between a browser and the app!

This simplified process allows your team to get up and running quickly so you can focus on other priorities.

Learn more

User limits vary per plan type.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Mobile App
Desktop App
New Feature
Consistently meet client expectations with arrival windows
Shared by Cam • March 23, 2023

Home service professionals deal with unexpected situations every day. How do you stay on track when the smallest things can derail your day?

Communicating an arrival window instead of a fixed time makes it easier for you to stay on schedule and meet client expectations consistently.

Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Add a window after the start time or center the window on the start time, whichever works best for your operations. Set a default window for all your jobs, and customize each one as needed. Arrival windows give you greater flexibility to manage your time so you can continue to provide the best service to your clients.

Learn more

Arrival windows, booking confirmations, and visit reminders are available on Connect and Grow plans.

For your clients to receive arrival window information, booking confirmations and/or visit reminders need to be enabled.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Mobile App
Feature Update
Send on my way text messages with a callback number
Shared by Cam • March 14, 2023

Stop playing phone tag with your team and ensure your clients reach the right person, every time. You and your team can now include your personal or business number when sending an on my way text.

With a personal number included in the message, customers can directly contact their assigned service pro for any concerns.

To enable this feature, add the phone numbers of your team members under Gear Icon > Manage Team in Jobber Online.

Learn more

On my way text messaging is available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Add a window after the start time or center the window on the start time, whichever works best for your operations. Set a default window for all your jobs, and customize each one as needed. Arrival windows give you greater flexibility to manage your time so you can continue to provide the best service to your clients.

Learn more

Arrival windows, booking confirmations, and visit reminders are available on Connect and Grow plans.

For your clients to receive arrival window information, booking confirmations and/or visit reminders need to be enabled.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Mobile App
Feature Update
Send on my way text messages with a callback number
Shared by Cam • March 14, 2023

Stop playing phone tag with your team and ensure your clients reach the right person, every time. You and your team can now include your personal or business number when sending an on my way text.

With a personal number included in the message, customers can directly contact their assigned service pro for any concerns.

To enable this feature, add the phone numbers of your team members under Gear Icon > Manage Team in Jobber Online.

## Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with Referrals!

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more

Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Getting your team started with Jobber is now easier than ever
Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

We’ve updated the invitations that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running.

After adding them to your Jobber account, new non-admin users who join through their mobile device will receive an email or text with a link to download the Jobber mobile app. Once they download and open the app, all their details will be automatically filled in; all they have to do is set a password to complete the setup. No more switching back and forth between a browser and the app!

This simplified process allows your team to get up and running quickly so you can focus on other priorities.

You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Getting your team started with Jobber is now easier than ever
Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

We’ve updated the invitations that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running.

After adding them to your Jobber account, new non-admin users who join through their mobile device will receive an email or text with a link to download the Jobber mobile app. Once they download and open the app, all their details will be automatically filled in; all they have to do is set a password to complete the setup.
