## Get more done on the go 📱

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more

Shared by Rafael • May 10, 2023
Let Jobber and Zapier handle your routine tasks

Automate repetitive tasks by setting up triggers in one app to automatically complete actions in another app. With Zapier integration you can connect Jobber with 2000+ apps for automated workflows

To get started find Zapier in our App Marketplace or visit our Help Center to learn more.

Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with referrals!

Customers can now refer your business from the client hub.

“Refer a friend” prompts in client hub encourage customers to share booking links with their friends and family or on social media, so you can generate quality leads. Referred leads will arrive in Jobber as new requests, tagged with the name of the customer that referred them.

To get setup, toggle referrals “on” in your client hub settings or visit our Help Center for more information.

Shared by Rafael • May 10, 2023

You can now let leads and customers request work through your website or social media.

Generate more opportunities to get quality leads with Referrals!

Customers can now refer your business from the client hub.

“Refer a friend” prompts in client hub encourage customers to share booking links with their friends and family or on social media, so you can generate quality leads. Referred leads will arrive in Jobber as new requests, tagged with the name of the customer that referred them.

To get setup, toggle referrals “on” in your client hub settings or visit our Help Center for more information.

Connect additional apps to help grow your business

Google Local services ad integration (US only) connects you to customers with less effort. When customers find you through Google, with the Jobber integration, customers will also see an option to schedule an available time in your Jobber calendar.

Thumbtack (US only) is a marketplace for finding local professionals. Integrate Jobber with Thumbtack to spend less time looking for work and let Thumbtack match you with the jobs you want.

To learn more about our apps and integrations visit our Help Center

Mobile App
Desktop App
Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App

## Select multiple line items at once

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

Consistently meet client expectations with arrival windows
Shared by Cam • March 23, 2023

## Help your clients reach the right person, every time

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control your bookable hours with team member availability for online booking
Shared by Anna • June 09, 2023

You can now set specific booking availability for team members that are different from your business hours. This will allow you to better control when bookings can be made based on who is available and will ensure accurate and efficient assignments. This is especially helpful for businesses with team members who operate on different schedules throughout the week.

Learn more

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

New Feature
Desktop App
Save time on scheduling with online booking
Shared by Anna • May 31, 2023

Getting customers booked in your calendar is no easy task—especially considering all the back and forth communications it can take.

With Jobber’s new online booking feature, you can streamline your scheduling by letting leads and customers book an appointment with you online. You'll remain in control of your calendar while Jobber automatically schedules the job for you; no phone tag necessary.

Here's how it works

1️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKABLE SERVICES

Decide which of your services are right for online booking and add those to your bookable services. You can select from your existing product and services list or create a new service. Customers will see the name, description, duration, and estimated price you set so be clear and descriptive.

2️⃣ SET YOUR BOOKING AVAILABILITY

Decide which team members can be assigned to bookings and set them as your bookable team members. The dates and times customers can choose from will depend on their calendars. You can also set preferences for earliest availability and buffer times between bookings.

3️⃣ SET YOUR REVIEW & CONFIRM PAGE

Before customers complete their booking, they must review and confirm their details. Here you can include any messages you'd like your customer to see as well as a link to any terms and conditions that may apply to the booking.

That's it! You are ready to set your booking page live and let the bookings roll in.

Get started

Online booking is available on Connect and Grow plans. To learn more about the feature, visit our Help Center.

Desktop App
Feature Update
Introducing the redesigned one-off jobs report (beta)
Shared by Cam • May 18, 2023

With new filtering options and more data columns, the one-off jobs report has been redesigned to help you save time and find the information you need faster.

Using the new filters, quickly find jobs that have scheduled visits within a specified date range, jobs that were closed within a specified date range, or jobs that have one or more unscheduled visits.

The new report also includes over ten new fields, including line items, custom fields, billing address, service address, and more. See invoices and quotes related to the job and open them with a single click. Plus, customize your report and select which columns to display, or export your data as a CSV file.

See the redesigned one-off job reports in Jobber Online by going to Reports > Work Reports and selecting One-off job reports BETA. This will remain in beta while we continue to make improvements; until then, the old report (Legacy) will remain available for use.

Learn more

Product Bulletin
Mobile App
Desktop App
Spring forward with our latest releases 🌱
Shared by Cam • April 24, 2023

Over the last few months, we’ve delivered a lot of improvements across Jobber that will help your business run smoother as you head into the busy season. Check out our latest releases!

Get more done on the go 📱
Locate your appointments in the app

The new map view in the mobile app makes it easier to locate all your appointments while on the go. Quickly access job details and navigate to your next visit with just a tap. Managing a team? View their appointments on the map and keep track of their progress throughout the day.

More offline functionality

We know how important it is to have access to Jobber even when you’re in poor service areas. In addition to being able to access your latest visit details from when you were last online, you can now create and save text notes when your device is offline. The mobile app will store your notes locally and sync them when you're back online.

Select multiple line items at once

Creating or editing quotes, jobs, and invoices in the mobile app is faster than ever. You can now select multiple line items from your products and services list and each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. If you need to edit something, simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Level up customer convenience ⭐️
Share arrival windows to set clear expectations

Communicate arrival windows instead of a fixed start time to let your clients know when to expect you and add more flexibility to your day. Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Help your clients reach the right person, every time

When sending an "on my way" text, you or your team can include a callback number so your clients can contact their assigned service pro directly. No more playing phone tag with your team!

Easier employee account setup ✅

We’ve updated the invitation that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running. From the invitation, all they have to do is download the app, open it, and enter a password to complete their profile.

Mobile App
Feature Update
Getting your team started with Jobber is now easier than ever
Shared by Cam • April 05, 2023

We’ve updated the invitations that your team receives to join Jobber so it’s easier for them to independently set up their account and get up and running.

After adding them to your Jobber account, new non-admin users who join through their mobile device will receive an email or text with a link to download the Jobber mobile app. Once they download and open the app, all their details will be automatically filled in; all they have to do is set a password to complete the setup. No more switching back and forth between a browser and the app!

This simplified process allows your team to get up and running quickly so you can focus on other priorities.

Learn more

User limits vary per plan type.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

New Feature
Consistently meet client expectations with arrival windows
Shared by Cam • March 23, 2023

Home service professionals deal with unexpected situations every day. How do you stay on track when the smallest things can derail your day?

Communicating an arrival window instead of a fixed time makes it easier for you to stay on schedule and meet client expectations consistently.

Whenever you create or edit a job, you can now set an arrival window that will be included in client hub, booking confirmations, and visit reminders.

Add a window after the start time or center the window on the start time, whichever works best for your operations. Set a default window for all your jobs, and customize each one as needed. Arrival windows give you greater flexibility to manage your time so you can continue to provide the best service to your clients.

Learn more

Arrival windows, booking confirmations, and visit reminders are available on Connect and Grow plans.

For your clients to receive arrival window information, booking confirmations and/or visit reminders need to be enabled.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Send on my way text messages with a callback number
Shared by Cam • March 14, 2023

With a personal number included in the message, customers can directly contact their assigned service pro for any concerns.

To enable this feature, add the phone numbers of your team members under Gear Icon > Manage Team in Jobber Online.

## Consistently meet client expectations with arrival windows

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/16187-consistently-meet-client-expectations-with-arrival-windows

**Shared by:** Cam

**Date:** June 15, 2023

As a home service business owner, understanding if a job is profitable is a lot of work. With so much to do, it can be difficult to tell if you’re making money on a job.

Job costing lets you see profitability for one-off jobs without spending hours switching between spreadsheets, receipts, and bank statements.

See real-time job profitability

On your one-off job pages, you can now see a profit bar that automatically calculates your profitability based on your total price and total costs tracked for the job. This number updates automatically as you add and change costs so you can always stay on top of your margins.

Track all your costs in the same place you manage your job

Add material costs spent on the job by selecting line items from your Products and Services or by adding new line items as needed.

Automatically calculate labor costs with timesheets by setting a default labor rate for each of your employees. You can also enter time and labor costs manually.

Record expenses from anywhere to keep track of any additional costs. Upload accompanying receipts for more accuracy and easy reimbursement.

Improve pricing and cost estimates

The updated one-off jobs report lets you easily compare details for multiple jobs—price, costs, profits, custom fields, and more—so you can improve pricing and cost estimate accuracy for future jobs.

Learn more

Job costing is available on the Grow plan.

Arrival windows give you greater flexibility to manage your time so you can continue to provide the best service to your clients.

Learn more

Arrival windows, booking confirmations, and visit reminders are available on Connect and Grow plans.

For your clients to receive arrival window information, booking confirmations and/or visit reminders need to be enabled.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Mobile App
Feature Update
Send on my way text messages with a callback number
Shared by Cam • March 14, 2023

Stop playing phone tag with your team and ensure your clients reach the right person, every time. You and your team can now include your personal or business number when sending an on my way text.

With a personal number included in the message, customers can directly contact their assigned service pro for any concerns.

To enable this feature, add the phone numbers of your team members under Gear Icon > Manage Team in Jobber Online.

Learn more

On my way text messaging is available on Connect and Grow plans in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

## Select multiple line items at once in the mobile app

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/15004-select-multiple-line-items-at-once-in-the-mobile-app

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** March 08, 2023

When you’re working in the field, you need to be able to act on your work quickly from the mobile app–especially when you’re with your client.

Now, you can quickly create or edit Quotes, Jobs, and Invoices from the mobile app by selecting multiple line items at once from your products and services list, rather than one at a time. Once you’ve added the line items, each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. Need to edit something? Simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Be sure to keep the Jobber Mobile App updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check for updates
Mobile App
New Feature
Locate your appointments with the new map view
Shared by Cam • March 01, 2023

Appointment locations have a huge impact on your daily operations. Having a clear understanding of where you need to be and when you need to be there makes planning your day easier.

The new map view in the app lets you visualize where all your daily appointments are, so you can stay on track and make better scheduling decisions on the go. With just a few taps, access full visit details and navigate to your client's property using your navigation app of choice.

Managing a team? Stay on top of their progress using the map. Easily see which team member is assigned to a location and how many appointments they have completed for the day. Even on the move, you can dispatch last-minute appointments efficiently by knowing where your team is.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Mobile App
Create and save text notes while offline
Shared by Cam • February 24, 2023

Having unreliable data service can be a problem when you're always on the go. Now, you can document your work and keep track of important details even when your connection is down.

While offline, create and save your text notes as usual and they will be temporarily stored on your device locally. Notes you make will automatically sync once your app is reconnected to the internet, ensuring you and your team are always up to date on the work that you do.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Mobile App
Desktop App
The best of 2022 and a peek at what's ahead
Shared by Anna • January 11, 2023

Here at Jobber, we know the level of care and effort that home service professionals like you put into your business. Throughout the past year, we’ve been hard at work building and improving tools that will help your business continue to run smoothly, so you can continue to focus on making it a success.

Here's a quick recap at the biggest updates from 2022 and a sneak peek at some of the things we’re working on for you!

Run your business from anywhere 📱

The Jobber app has been completely rebuilt to better power your day-to-day. We plan to continue this momentum into 2023, with the below features rolling out shortly to all users.

Find and capture work details more effectively

Finding the work you’re looking for has never been easier with new search filters throughout the app. Plus, the new Search tab (formerly Client tab) lets you search through all your clients, quotes, jobs, and invoices at once, making it easier to find what you need.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Job form alerts ensure any empty job forms are filled out before a visit is marked as completed
Image uploads over a cellular connection are up to 300% faster so you can spend less time waiting and more time actioning work

Better visibility into your schedule

Keeping a pulse on how your team is progressing through the day is easier than ever. You can access your team members' schedule from any schedule view, including list view which shows all their active timers.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Access important visit details for the day, even when you’re in poor service areas
3-day and weekly schedule views that help you make faster scheduling decisions on the go

Smoother customer experience

If clients try to call your Jobber text messaging number, you don’t want them to reach a dead-end. Now, those calls will be automatically forwarded to your business phone number, so you don’t lose a call – or opportunity.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Keep your clients informed by quickly sending booking confirmations from the app
Control who from your team receives email replies and notifications so the right person is informed and can take action

More helpful apps and tools in the App Marketplace 🔗

Integrate your favorite apps and software seamlessly with Jobber. Here are some of the newest additions and updates available in the App Marketplace.

Let Thumbtack match you with the jobs you want, then seamlessly manage these clients and track jobs from start to finish all from Jobber.
The new Report Scheduler App gets reports from Jobber delivered to your inbox on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule.
Referrals are the cheapest, fastest way to land new clients. LoyalAs automates your referral program so you get quality leads in Jobber that close at a higher rate.
You can now sync CompanyCam photos to every stage of your Jobber workflow: from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices.

Want to see more updates? Check out all our product announcements here.

Sneak peek at what’s to come 👀

We love all the feedback you share with us about how we can make Jobber better. So here’s a sneak peek at just a few of the improvements we are tackling this year based on what we’ve heard from you.

You need an easy way to navigate through your day while on the go. Using a map view on the mobile app will help you locate your daily appointments and stay on track.
Unexpected delays happen. Help better manage your client’s expectations by setting an arrival window rather than a fixed arrival time.
You need to ensure every job you take on is profitable. Tracking job costs and profit margins for each job helps you make informed decisions so you can maximize your profitability.
Booking new jobs can be a lot of admin work. Offering your services online means that your clients can book directly into your calendar–no phone tag required.

All of this to look forward to, and so much more! We’re excited to continue being your trusted partner and help make your business even better.

Please note that the availability and timing of upcoming features are subject to change.

Integrations
Let your photos do the heavy lifting with CompanyCam
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

The CompanyCam integration lets you sync detailed photos from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices!

When you use CompanyCam photos from start to finish, you save time by keeping your team aligned on the work that needs to be done.

Requests and quotes: Use photos to help your team, and clients, better understand the scope of work.
Jobs: Capture the details from every job site and keep your team, and clients, informed along the way.
Invoices: Show before and after photos of the work your team has accomplished that will wow your clients.

CompanyCam is a photo-based solution created for contractors, by contractors. Users can take unlimited photos, organized by project and instantly available in the cloud. Sign up for a free 30-day trial here.

Learn more

Feature Update
Mobile App
Find your work more easily with filters in the updated mobile app
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

Our new filters make it easier to find the work you’re looking for while on the go.

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New status filters in the Clients tab
New filters in the Work tab of the client profile
New filters in the visits section on the Job page

In the Clients tab, you can now filter clients, requests, quotes, jobs, and invoices by status. This makes it easier for you to find and take action on specific types of work, such as unscheduled jobs or past-due invoices, or follow up with leads.

We heard loud and clear that for some businesses, having everything in one list in the client profile’s Work tab was not efficient. To make it easier and faster for you to find the specific item you're looking for, you can now filter by the type of work, such as quotes or invoices.

When you have multiple visits for the same job, finding a specific one can be tricky. If you have more than five visits for a job, you will be able to filter the visits section on the Job page by unscheduled, late, upcoming, and more. This way, unscheduled and late visits can be tracked down and followed up on more quickly.

Learn more about the updated app experience here.

The Clients tab on the mobile app is accessible to admins, owners, and employees with the user permissions enabled to "view clients on their Jobber menu".

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control who should receive email replies from your clients
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

Easily manage your team’s email communications by designating who gets email responses and notifications through Settings > Email & Text Messages > Email Reply Settings.

Set where replies or notifications should go by selecting Company email, eligible users or sender of email.

To allow for more flexibility, users can also change the reply-to address for a specific email to be different from the default email reply settings when they compose their email on Jobber Online or the mobile app.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Mobile App
Easily communicate with clients on-the-go using the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Booking confirmations can now be sent through the app
Call or text your client from their profile or any of their work

We’ve introduced a few updates that help you manage communications more smoothly while on-the-go. Through the app, you can now send booking confirmations for any upcoming jobs. Additionally, you can now easily call or send a two-way text to your client from their profile, quote, job, visit or invoice. This helps you stay on task by having your client’s details handy.

Learn more

With two-way text messaging , you and your team can text with customers while on-the-go, knowing that conversations are stored in Jobber for everyone’s reference. Two-way text messaging is available on the Grow plan in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Feature Update
Mobile App
Make faster scheduling decisions in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New three-day schedule view
New weekly schedule view
Team member filters now apply to all schedule views
List view now shows active timers

Scheduling in the updated app has never been easier. At a glance, you can now see your availability across multiple days with the new three-day and weekly schedule view. Narrow in on your schedule or, using the filter options, select which team members’ schedules to look at. The team member filter now applies to all schedule views.

The list view has also been improved. In addition to seeing the progress indicator for the day, you can also see any active timers your team members may have running. This view should help provide you with a snapshot of how the day is going.

Get your work done more easily in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Get directions from your favorite app
Improved photo upload performance
See today’s visits even in poor service areas
Line item images from quotes now show up in visits

We’ve made multiple updates to help you get your work done faster. You can now get directions to your job site using your favorite maps app by tapping the direction icon on the visit screen. Photos now upload more quickly, giving you more time to focus on delivering results for your client.

You can keep track of today's visits even in areas with poor service. In areas with limited service, the updated app displays visit information from when you were last online. And finally, all line item images added to a quote will now show up in the corresponding visit, so you can quickly see the work that needs to be done.

With line item images, you can show your clients a preview of the products and services that you are offering them. Line item images are available on the Grow plan.

Invoices: Show before and after photos of the work your team has accomplished that will wow your clients.

CompanyCam is a photo-based solution created for contractors, by contractors. Users can take unlimited photos, organized by project and instantly available in the cloud. Sign up for a free 30-day trial here.

Learn more

Feature Update
Mobile App
Find your work more easily with filters in the updated mobile app
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

Our new filters make it easier to find the work you’re looking for while on the go.

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New status filters in the Clients tab
New filters in the Work tab of the client profile
New filters in the visits section on the Job page

In the Clients tab, you can now filter clients, requests, quotes, jobs, and invoices by status. This makes it easier for you to find and take action on specific types of work, such as unscheduled jobs or past-due invoices, or follow up with leads.

We heard loud and clear that for some businesses, having everything in one list in the client profile’s Work tab was not efficient. To make it easier and faster for you to find the specific item you're looking for, you can now filter by the type of work, such as quotes or invoices.

When you have multiple visits for the same job, finding a specific one can be tricky. If you have more than five visits for a job, you will be able to filter the visits section on the Job page by unscheduled, late, upcoming, and more. This way, unscheduled and late visits can be tracked down and followed up on more quickly.

Learn more about the updated app experience here.

The Clients tab on the mobile app is accessible to admins, owners, and employees with the user permissions enabled to "view clients on their Jobber menu".

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

Booking confirmations can now be sent through the app
Call or text your client from their profile or any of their work

Make faster scheduling decisions in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New three-day schedule view
New weekly schedule view
Team member filters now apply to all schedule views
List view now shows active timers

Scheduling in the updated app has never been easier. At a glance, you can now see your availability across multiple days with the new three-day and weekly schedule view. Narrow in on your schedule or, using the filter options, select which team members’ schedules to look at. The team member filter now applies to all schedule views.

The list view has also been improved. In addition to seeing the progress indicator for the day, you can also see any active timers your team members may have running. This view should help provide you with a snapshot of how the day is going.

Get your work done more easily in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Get directions from your favorite app
Improved photo upload performance
See today’s visits even in poor service areas
Line item images from quotes now show up in visits

We’ve made multiple updates to help you get your work done faster. You can now get directions to your job site using your favorite maps app by tapping the direction icon on the visit screen. Photos now upload more quickly, giving you more time to focus on delivering results for your client.

You can keep track of today's visits even in areas with poor service. In areas with limited service, the updated app displays visit information from when you were last online. ## The best of 2022 and a peek at what's ahead

**URL:** https://productupdates.getjobber.com/9511-the-best-of-2022-and-a-peek-at-what-s-ahead

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** March 08, 2023

When you’re working in the field, you need to be able to act on your work quickly from the mobile app–especially when you’re with your client.

Now, you can quickly create or edit Quotes, Jobs, and Invoices from the mobile app by selecting multiple line items at once from your products and services list, rather than one at a time. Once you’ve added the line items, each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. Need to edit something? Simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Be sure to keep the Jobber Mobile App updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Mobile App
New Feature
Locate your appointments with the new map view
Shared by Cam • March 01, 2023

Appointment locations have a huge impact on your daily operations. Having a clear understanding of where you need to be and when you need to be there makes planning your day easier.

The new map view in the app lets you visualize where all your daily appointments are, so you can stay on track and make better scheduling decisions on the go. With just a few taps, access full visit details and navigate to your client's property using your navigation app of choice.

Managing a team? Stay on top of their progress using the map. Easily see which team member is assigned to a location and how many appointments they have completed for the day. Even on the move, you can dispatch last-minute appointments efficiently by knowing where your team is.

Feature Update
Mobile App
Create and save text notes while offline
Shared by Cam • February 24, 2023

Having unreliable data service can be a problem when you're always on the go. Now, you can document your work and keep track of important details even when your connection is down.

While offline, create and save your text notes as usual and they will be temporarily stored on your device locally. Notes you make will automatically sync once your app is reconnected to the internet, ensuring you and your team are always up to date on the work that you do.

Mobile App
Desktop App
The best of 2022 and a peek at what's ahead
Shared by Anna • January 11, 2023

Here at Jobber, we know the level of care and effort that home service professionals like you put into your business. Throughout the past year, we’ve been hard at work building and improving tools that will help your business continue to run smoothly, so you can continue to focus on making it a success.

Here's a quick recap at the biggest updates from 2022 and a sneak peek at some of the things we’re working on for you!

Run your business from anywhere 📱

The Jobber app has been completely rebuilt to better power your day-to-day. We plan to continue this momentum into 2023, with the below features rolling out shortly to all users.

Find and capture work details more effectively

Finding the work you’re looking for has never been easier with new search filters throughout the app. Plus, the new Search tab (formerly Client tab) lets you search through all your clients, quotes, jobs, and invoices at once, making it easier to find what you need.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Job form alerts ensure any empty job forms are filled out before a visit is marked as completed
Image uploads over a cellular connection are up to 300% faster so you can spend less time waiting and more time actioning work

Better visibility into your schedule

Keeping a pulse on how your team is progressing through the day is easier than ever. You can access your team members' schedule from any schedule view, including list view which shows all their active timers.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Access important visit details for the day, even when you’re in poor service areas
3-day and weekly schedule views that help you make faster scheduling decisions on the go

Smoother customer experience

If clients try to call your Jobber text messaging number, you don’t want them to reach a dead-end. Now, those calls will be automatically forwarded to your business phone number, so you don’t lose a call – or opportunity.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Keep your clients informed by quickly sending booking confirmations from the app
Control who from your team receives email replies and notifications so the right person is informed and can take action

More helpful apps and tools in the App Marketplace 🔗

Integrate your favorite apps and software seamlessly with Jobber. Here are some of the newest additions and updates available in the App Marketplace.

Let Thumbtack match you with the jobs you want, then seamlessly manage these clients and track jobs from start to finish all from Jobber.
The new Report Scheduler App gets reports from Jobber delivered to your inbox on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule.
Referrals are the cheapest, fastest way to land new clients. LoyalAs automates your referral program so you get quality leads in Jobber that close at a higher rate.
You can now sync CompanyCam photos to every stage of your Jobber workflow: from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices.

Want to see more updates? Check out all our product announcements here.

Sneak peek at what’s to come 👀

We love all the feedback you share with us about how we can make Jobber better. So here’s a sneak peek at just a few of the improvements we are tackling this year based on what we’ve heard from you.

You need an easy way to navigate through your day while on the go. Using a map view on the mobile app will help you locate your daily appointments and stay on track.
Unexpected delays happen. Help better manage your client’s expectations by setting an arrival window rather than a fixed arrival time.
You need to ensure every job you take on is profitable. Tracking job costs and profit margins for each job helps you make informed decisions so you can maximize your profitability.
Booking new jobs can be a lot of admin work. Offering your services online means that your clients can book directly into your calendar–no phone tag required.

All of this to look forward to, and so much more! We’re excited to continue being your trusted partner and help make your business even better.

Please note that the availability and timing of upcoming features are subject to change.

Here at Jobber, we know the level of care and effort that home service professionals like you put into your business. Throughout the past year, we’ve been hard at work building and improving tools that will help your business continue to run smoothly, so you can continue to focus on making it a success.

Here's a quick recap at the biggest updates from 2022 and a sneak peek at some of the things we’re working on for you!

Run your business from anywhere 📱

The Jobber app has been completely rebuilt to better power your day-to-day. We plan to continue this momentum into 2023, with the below features rolling out shortly to all users.

Find and capture work details more effectively

Finding the work you’re looking for has never been easier with new search filters throughout the app. Plus, the new Search tab (formerly Client tab) lets you search through all your clients, quotes, jobs, and invoices at once, making it easier to find what you need.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Job form alerts ensure any empty job forms are filled out before a visit is marked as completed
Image uploads over a cellular connection are up to 300% faster so you can spend less time waiting and more time actioning work

Better visibility into your schedule

Keeping a pulse on how your team is progressing through the day is easier than ever. You can access your team members' schedule from any schedule view, including list view which shows all their active timers.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Access important visit details for the day, even when you’re in poor service areas
3-day and weekly schedule views that help you make faster scheduling decisions on the go

Smoother customer experience

If clients try to call your Jobber text messaging number, you don’t want them to reach a dead-end. Now, those calls will be automatically forwarded to your business phone number, so you don’t lose a call – or opportunity.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Keep your clients informed by quickly sending booking confirmations from the app
Control who from your team receives email replies and notifications so the right person is informed and can take action

More helpful apps and tools in the App Marketplace 🔗

Integrate your favorite apps and software seamlessly with Jobber. Here are some of the newest additions and updates available in the App Marketplace.

Let Thumbtack match you with the jobs you want, then seamlessly manage these clients and track jobs from start to finish all from Jobber.
The new Report Scheduler App gets reports from Jobber delivered to your inbox on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule.
Referrals are the cheapest, fastest way to land new clients. LoyalAs automates your referral program so you get quality leads in Jobber that close at a higher rate.
You can now sync CompanyCam photos to every stage of your Jobber workflow: from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices.

Want to see more updates? Check out all our product announcements here.

Sneak peek at what’s to come 👀

We love all the feedback you share with us about how we can make Jobber better. So here’s a sneak peek at just a few of the improvements we are tackling this year based on what we’ve heard from you.

You need an easy way to navigate through your day while on the go. Using a map view on the mobile app will help you locate your daily appointments and stay on track.
Unexpected delays happen. Help better manage your client’s expectations by setting an arrival window rather than a fixed arrival time.
You need to ensure every job you take on is profitable. Tracking job costs and profit margins for each job helps you make informed decisions so you can maximize your profitability.
Booking new jobs can be a lot of admin work. Offering your services online means that your clients can book directly into your calendar–no phone tag required.

All of this to look forward to, and so much more! We’re excited to continue being your trusted partner and help make your business even better.

Please note that the availability and timing of upcoming features are subject to change.

Integrations
Let your photos do the heavy lifting with CompanyCam
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

The CompanyCam integration lets you sync detailed photos from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices!

When you use CompanyCam photos from start to finish, you save time by keeping your team aligned on the work that needs to be done.

Requests and quotes: Use photos to help your team, and clients, better understand the scope of work.
Jobs: Capture the details from every job site and keep your team, and clients, informed along the way.
Invoices: Show before and after photos of the work your team has accomplished that will wow your clients.

CompanyCam is a photo-based solution created for contractors, by contractors. Users can take unlimited photos, organized by project and instantly available in the cloud. Sign up for a free 30-day trial here.

Learn more

Feature Update
Mobile App
Find your work more easily with filters in the updated mobile app
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

Our new filters make it easier to find the work you’re looking for while on the go.

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New status filters in the Clients tab
New filters in the Work tab of the client profile
New filters in the visits section on the Job page

In the Clients tab, you can now filter clients, requests, quotes, jobs, and invoices by status. This makes it easier for you to find and take action on specific types of work, such as unscheduled jobs or past-due invoices, or follow up with leads.

We heard loud and clear that for some businesses, having everything in one list in the client profile’s Work tab was not efficient. To make it easier and faster for you to find the specific item you're looking for, you can now filter by the type of work, such as quotes or invoices.

When you have multiple visits for the same job, finding a specific one can be tricky. If you have more than five visits for a job, you will be able to filter the visits section on the Job page by unscheduled, late, upcoming, and more. This way, unscheduled and late visits can be tracked down and followed up on more quickly.

Learn more about the updated app experience here.

The Clients tab on the mobile app is accessible to admins, owners, and employees with the user permissions enabled to "view clients on their Jobber menu".

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control who should receive email replies from your clients
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

Easily manage your team’s email communications by designating who gets email responses and notifications through Settings > Email & Text Messages > Email Reply Settings.

Set where replies or notifications should go by selecting Company email, eligible users or sender of email.

To allow for more flexibility, users can also change the reply-to address for a specific email to be different from the default email reply settings when they compose their email on Jobber Online or the mobile app.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Mobile App
Easily communicate with clients on-the-go using the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Booking confirmations can now be sent through the app
Call or text your client from their profile or any of their work

We’ve introduced a few updates that help you manage communications more smoothly while on-the-go. Through the app, you can now send booking confirmations for any upcoming jobs. Additionally, you can now easily call or send a two-way text to your client from their profile, quote, job, visit or invoice. This helps you stay on task by having your client’s details handy.

Learn more

With two-way text messaging , you and your team can text with customers while on-the-go, knowing that conversations are stored in Jobber for everyone’s reference. Two-way text messaging is available on the Grow plan in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates

Feature Update
Mobile App
Make faster scheduling decisions in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New three-day schedule view
New weekly schedule view
Team member filters now apply to all schedule views
List view now shows active timers

Scheduling in the updated app has never been easier. At a glance, you can now see your availability across multiple days with the new three-day and weekly schedule view. Narrow in on your schedule or, using the filter options, select which team members’ schedules to look at. The team member filter now applies to all schedule views.

The list view has also been improved. In addition to seeing the progress indicator for the day, you can also see any active timers your team members may have running. This view should help provide you with a snapshot of how the day is going.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates

Feature Update
Mobile App
Get your work done more easily in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Get directions from your favorite app
Improved photo upload performance
See today’s visits even in poor service areas
Line item images from quotes now show up in visits

We’ve made multiple updates to help you get your work done faster. You can now get directions to your job site using your favorite maps app by tapping the direction icon on the visit screen. Photos now upload more quickly, giving you more time to focus on delivering results for your client.

You can keep track of today's visits even in areas with poor service. In areas with limited service, the updated app displays visit information from when you were last online. And finally, all line item images added to a quote will now show up in the corresponding visit, so you can quickly see the work that needs to be done.

Learn more

With line item images, you can show your clients a preview of the products and services that you are offering them. Line item images are available on the Grow plan.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

## Better visibility into your schedule

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** March 08, 2023

When you’re working in the field, you need to be able to act on your work quickly from the mobile app–especially when you’re with your client.

Now, you can quickly create or edit Quotes, Jobs, and Invoices from the mobile app by selecting multiple line items at once from your products and services list, rather than one at a time. Once you’ve added the line items, each line item will appear in the order that you selected them. Need to edit something? Simply tap on the line item to edit any of the details.

Be sure to keep the Jobber Mobile App updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check for updates
Mobile App
New Feature
Locate your appointments with the new map view
Shared by Cam • March 01, 2023

Appointment locations have a huge impact on your daily operations. Having a clear understanding of where you need to be and when you need to be there makes planning your day easier.

The new map view in the app lets you visualize where all your daily appointments are, so you can stay on track and make better scheduling decisions on the go. With just a few taps, access full visit details and navigate to your client's property using your navigation app of choice.

Managing a team? Stay on top of their progress using the map. Easily see which team member is assigned to a location and how many appointments they have completed for the day. Even on the move, you can dispatch last-minute appointments efficiently by knowing where your team is.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates
Feature Update
Mobile App
Create and save text notes while offline
Shared by Cam • February 24, 2023

Having unreliable data service can be a problem when you're always on the go. Now, you can document your work and keep track of important details even when your connection is down.

While offline, create and save your text notes as usual and they will be temporarily stored on your device locally. Notes you make will automatically sync once your app is reconnected to the internet, ensuring you and your team are always up to date on the work that you do.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Get directions from your favorite app
Improved photo upload performance
See today’s visits even in poor service areas
Line item images from quotes now show up in visits

We’ve made multiple updates to help you get your work done faster. You can now get directions to your job site using your favorite maps app by tapping the direction icon on the visit screen. Photos now upload more quickly, giving you more time to focus on delivering results for your client.

You can keep track of today's visits even in areas with poor service. In areas with limited service, the updated app displays visit information from when you were last online. And finally, all line item images added to a quote will now show up in the corresponding visit, so you can quickly see the work that needs to be done.

Learn more

With line item images, you can show your clients a preview of the products and services that you are offering them. Line item images are available on the Grow plan.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

## More helpful apps and tools in the App Marketplace 🔗

**Shared by:** Anna

**Date:** March 08, 2023

When you’re working in the field, you need to be able to act on your work quickly from the mobile app–especially when you’re with your client.

Managing a team? Stay on top of their progress using the map. Easily see which team member is assigned to a location and how many appointments they have completed for the day. Even on the move, you can dispatch last-minute appointments efficiently by knowing where your team is.

Create and save text notes while offline
Shared by Cam • February 24, 2023

Having unreliable data service can be a problem when you're always on the go. Now, you can document your work and keep track of important details even when your connection is down.

The best of 2022 and a peek at what's ahead
Shared by Anna • January 11, 2023

Here at Jobber, we know the level of care and effort that home service professionals like you put into your business. Throughout the past year, we’ve been hard at work building and improving tools that will help your business continue to run smoothly, so you can continue to focus on making it a success.

Here's a quick recap at the biggest updates from 2022 and a sneak peek at some of the things we’re working on for you!

Run your business from anywhere 📱

The Jobber app has been completely rebuilt to better power your day-to-day. We plan to continue this momentum into 2023, with the below features rolling out shortly to all users.

Find and capture work details more effectively

Finding the work you’re looking for has never been easier with new search filters throughout the app. Plus, the new Search tab (formerly Client tab) lets you search through all your clients, quotes, jobs, and invoices at once, making it easier to find what you need.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Job form alerts ensure any empty job forms are filled out before a visit is marked as completed
Image uploads over a cellular connection are up to 300% faster so you can spend less time waiting and more time actioning work

Better visibility into your schedule

Keeping a pulse on how your team is progressing through the day is easier than ever. You can access your team members' schedule from any schedule view, including list view which shows all their active timers.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Access important visit details for the day, even when you’re in poor service areas
3-day and weekly schedule views that help you make faster scheduling decisions on the go

Smoother customer experience

If clients try to call your Jobber text messaging number, you don’t want them to reach a dead-end. Now, those calls will be automatically forwarded to your business phone number, so you don’t lose a call – or opportunity.

Some other improvements we delivered:

Keep your clients informed by quickly sending booking confirmations from the app
Control who from your team receives email replies and notifications so the right person is informed and can take action

More helpful apps and tools in the App Marketplace 🔗

Integrate your favorite apps and software seamlessly with Jobber. Here are some of the newest additions and updates available in the App Marketplace.

Let Thumbtack match you with the jobs you want, then seamlessly manage these clients and track jobs from start to finish all from Jobber.
The new Report Scheduler App gets reports from Jobber delivered to your inbox on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule.
Referrals are the cheapest, fastest way to land new clients. LoyalAs automates your referral program so you get quality leads in Jobber that close at a higher rate.
You can now sync CompanyCam photos to every stage of your Jobber workflow: from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices.

Want to see more updates? Check out all our product announcements here.

Sneak peek at what’s to come 👀

We love all the feedback you share with us about how we can make Jobber better. So here’s a sneak peek at just a few of the improvements we are tackling this year based on what we’ve heard from you.

You need an easy way to navigate through your day while on the go. Using a map view on the mobile app will help you locate your daily appointments and stay on track.
Unexpected delays happen. Help better manage your client’s expectations by setting an arrival window rather than a fixed arrival time.
You need to ensure every job you take on is profitable. Tracking job costs and profit margins for each job helps you make informed decisions so you can maximize your profitability.
Booking new jobs can be a lot of admin work. Offering your services online means that your clients can book directly into your calendar–no phone tag required.

All of this to look forward to, and so much more! We’re excited to continue being your trusted partner and help make your business even better.

Please note that the availability and timing of upcoming features are subject to change.

Integrations
Let your photos do the heavy lifting with CompanyCam
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

The CompanyCam integration lets you sync detailed photos from requests and quotes, to jobs and invoices!

When you use CompanyCam photos from start to finish, you save time by keeping your team aligned on the work that needs to be done.

Requests and quotes: Use photos to help your team, and clients, better understand the scope of work.
Jobs: Capture the details from every job site and keep your team, and clients, informed along the way.
Invoices: Show before and after photos of the work your team has accomplished that will wow your clients.

CompanyCam is a photo-based solution created for contractors, by contractors. Users can take unlimited photos, organized by project and instantly available in the cloud. Sign up for a free 30-day trial here.

Learn more

Feature Update
Mobile App
Find your work more easily with filters in the updated mobile app
Shared by Cam • January 03, 2023

Our new filters make it easier to find the work you’re looking for while on the go.

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New status filters in the Clients tab
New filters in the Work tab of the client profile
New filters in the visits section on the Job page

In the Clients tab, you can now filter clients, requests, quotes, jobs, and invoices by status. This makes it easier for you to find and take action on specific types of work, such as unscheduled jobs or past-due invoices, or follow up with leads.

We heard loud and clear that for some businesses, having everything in one list in the client profile’s Work tab was not efficient. To make it easier and faster for you to find the specific item you're looking for, you can now filter by the type of work, such as quotes or invoices.

When you have multiple visits for the same job, finding a specific one can be tricky. If you have more than five visits for a job, you will be able to filter the visits section on the Job page by unscheduled, late, upcoming, and more. This way, unscheduled and late visits can be tracked down and followed up on more quickly.

Learn more about the updated app experience here.

The Clients tab on the mobile app is accessible to admins, owners, and employees with the user permissions enabled to "view clients on their Jobber menu".

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Check app for updates

Feature Update
Desktop App
Control who should receive email replies from your clients
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

Easily manage your team’s email communications by designating who gets email responses and notifications through Settings > Email & Text Messages > Email Reply Settings.

Set where replies or notifications should go by selecting Company email, eligible users or sender of email.

To allow for more flexibility, users can also change the reply-to address for a specific email to be different from the default email reply settings when they compose their email on Jobber Online or the mobile app.

Learn more

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Mobile App
Easily communicate with clients on-the-go using the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

Booking confirmations can now be sent through the app
Call or text your client from their profile or any of their work

We’ve introduced a few updates that help you manage communications more smoothly while on-the-go. Through the app, you can now send booking confirmations for any upcoming jobs. Additionally, you can now easily call or send a two-way text to your client from their profile, quote, job, visit or invoice. This helps you stay on task by having your client’s details handy.

Learn more

With two-way text messaging , you and your team can text with customers while on-the-go, knowing that conversations are stored in Jobber for everyone’s reference. Two-way text messaging is available on the Grow plan in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom.

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

In the Clients tab, you can now filter clients, requests, quotes, jobs, and invoices by status. This makes it easier for you to find and take action on specific types of work, such as unscheduled jobs or past-due invoices, or follow up with leads.

We heard loud and clear that for some businesses, having everything in one list in the client profile’s Work tab was not efficient. To make it easier and faster for you to find the specific item you're looking for, you can now filter by the type of work, such as quotes or invoices.

When you have multiple visits for the same job, finding a specific one can be tricky. If you have more than five visits for a job, you will be able to filter the visits section on the Job page by unscheduled, late, upcoming, and more. This way, unscheduled and late visits can be tracked down and followed up on more quickly.

Learn more about the updated app experience here.

The Clients tab on the mobile app is accessible to admins, owners, and employees with the user permissions enabled to "view clients on their Jobber menu".

Be sure to keep the Jobber app updated to get access to the latest and greatest updates!

Set where replies or notifications should go by selecting Company email, eligible users or sender of email.

Make faster scheduling decisions in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

These updates will apply to users on the updated app experience:

New three-day schedule view
New weekly schedule view
Team member filters now apply to all schedule views
List view now shows active timers

Scheduling in the updated app has never been easier. At a glance, you can now see your availability across multiple days with the new three-day and weekly schedule view. Narrow in on your schedule or, using the filter options, select which team members’ schedules to look at. The team member filter now applies to all schedule views.

Get your work done more easily in the updated app
Shared by Anna • January 03, 2023

Get directions from your favorite app
Improved photo upload performance
See today’s visits even in poor service areas
Line item images from quotes now show up in visits
